```js
// who has them, and the changes admins and project managers make
// =====================================================================

function teamsFailed(res, error, what) {
  if (error instanceof teams.AccessError) return res.status(403).json({ error: error.message });
  console.error(`👥 ${what} failed:`, error.message);
  res.status(503).json({ error: `${what} could not be done right now.` });
}

app.get('/api/teams', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    res.json(await teams.listTeams(req.scope));
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Loading the teams');
  }
});

// A Team tab list's ?sort=&dir= and ?q=&col=, over what each ticket's summary
// says (teams.mjs checks the numbers before it sorts or looks them up).
// sorts: the ?sort= values it takes (teams.mjs orders 'family', 'assignee'
// and 'team' itself). textsOf(row, summary): what each column shows.
// -> { sort, matches } for teams.teamTickets / teams.unassignedTickets
async function teamListOptions(query, columns, sorts, textsOf) {
  const lookup = parseLookup(query, columns);
  const index = lookup || ['type', 'summary', 'state'].includes(query.sort) ? await loadTicketIndex(runCubeQuery) : null;
  let sort = null;
  if (sorts.includes(query.sort)) {
    const by = query.sort;
    sort = {
      by, dir: query.dir === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc',
      valueOf: number => (by === 'number' ? number : index.has(number) ? TICKET_SORTS[by](index.get(number)) : null),
    };
  }
  const matches = lookup && (r => lookupMatches(textsOf(r, index.get(r.number) || {}), lookup));
  return { sort, matches };
}

// The Team tab's ticket columns, for looking tickets up
const TEAM_TICKET_LOOKUP_COLUMNS = ['Ticket', 'Type', 'Summary', 'State', 'Family', 'Assigned to'];
const UNASSIGNED_LOOKUP_COLUMNS = ['Ticket', 'Type', 'Summary', 'State', 'Family', 'Team'];

// Admins: every ticket nobody has yet, on any team or on none, family by family
// (the Team tab's "Not assigned yet"). ?team=<team id>|none&kind=INC&q=&col=&offset&limit
// &sort=number|type|summary|state|family|team&dir=asc|desc -> { total, before, tickets,
// families }: one page of tickets with each one's summary and team, and the page's
// families, each with what its first ticket is about
const UNASSIGNED_SORTS = ['number', 'type', 'summary', 'state', 'family', 'team'];
app.get('/api/teams/unassigned/tickets', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { sort, matches } = await teamListOptions(req.query, UNASSIGNED_LOOKUP_COLUMNS, UNASSIGNED_SORTS, (r, t) => ({
      Ticket: r.number, Type: t.type, Summary: t.summary || blankText('Summary', t), State: t.state || blankText('State', t),
      Family: r.familySize > 1 ? `${r.familyId} · ${r.familySize.toLocaleString()} linked tickets` : 'On its own',
      Team: r.team || 'No team',
    }));
    const page = await teams.unassignedTickets(req.scope, {
      team: req.query.team || null, kind: req.query.kind || null, matches,
      offset: req.query.offset, limit: req.query.limit, sort,
    });
    // An admin's: every number may be seen, so the summaries come straight from Cube
    const families = Object.values(page.families);
    const summaries = await ticketSummaries([...page.tickets.map(t => t.number), ...families.map(f => f.id)], runCubeQuery)
      .catch(error => { console.error('👥 Could not load ticket summaries:', error.message); return new Map(); });
    res.json({
      total: page.total, before: page.before,
      tickets: page.tickets.map(t => ({ ...summaries.get(t.number), ...t })),
      families: families.map(f => ({ ...f, summary: summaries.get(f.id)?.summary || null })),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Loading the tickets nobody has');
  }
});

// ?assignee=<user id>|none&kind=INC&q=<words>&col=<column>&offset&limit -> { total, before, tickets }:
// one page of a team's tickets with who has each one, and each one's summary
// ...&sort=number|type|summary|state|family|assignee&dir=asc|desc: every match in that order, then the page
const TEAM_TICKET_SORTS = ['number', 'type', 'summary', 'state', 'family', 'assignee'];
app.get('/api/teams/:id/tickets', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { sort, matches } = await teamListOptions(req.query, TEAM_TICKET_LOOKUP_COLUMNS, TEAM_TICKET_SORTS, (r, t) => ({
      Ticket: r.number, Type: t.type, Summary: t.summary || blankText('Summary', t), State: t.state || blankText('State', t),
      Family: r.familySize > 1 ? `${r.familySize.toLocaleString()} linked tickets` : 'On its own',
      'Assigned to': r.assignee || 'Not assigned',
    }));
    const page = await teams.teamTickets(req.scope, Number(req.params.id), {
      assignee: req.query.assignee || null, kind: req.query.kind || null, matches,
      offset: req.query.offset, limit: req.query.limit, sort,
    });
    // The numbers are already this person's to see, so their summaries come straight from Cube
    const summaries = await ticketSummaries(page.tickets.map(t => t.number), runCubeQuery)
      .catch(error => { console.error('👥 Could not load ticket summaries:', error.message); return new Map(); });
    res.json({ total: page.total, before: page.before, tickets: page.tickets.map(t => ({ ...summaries.get(t.number), ...t })) });
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Loading the team\'s tickets');
  }
});

// { numbers, assigneeId } (null: nobody) -> { changed }
app.put('/api/assignments', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const assigneeId = req.body?.assigneeId ?? null;
    const changed = await teams.assignTickets(req.scope, req.body?.numbers, assigneeId);
    console.log(`👥 ${req.user.username} assigned ${changed} tickets to user ${assigneeId ?? '(nobody)'}`);
    res.json({ changed });
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Assigning those tickets');
  }
});

// Admins: { teamId (null: off their team, and no role), role } for one person
// -> { unassigned }: how many of their tickets went back to the team
app.put('/api/teams/members/:userId', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const teamId = req.body?.teamId == null ? null : Number(req.body.teamId);
    const { unassigned } = await teams.setMembership(req.scope, Number(req.params.userId), teamId, req.body?.role);
    console.log(teamId === null
      ? `👥 ${req.user.username} took user ${req.params.userId} off their team (${unassigned} tickets unassigned)`
      : `👥 ${req.user.username} put user ${req.params.userId} on team ${teamId} as ${req.body?.role}`);
    res.json({ ok: true, unassigned });
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Changing that person\'s team');
  }
});

// Admins: ?number=INC1813970 -> { family }: the linked group that ticket is in, and its team
app.get('/api/ticket-families', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const family = await teams.familyOfTicket(req.scope, req.query.number);
    if (!family) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'That ticket isn\'t in the data.' });
    res.json({ family });
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Finding that family');
  }
});

// Admins: { teamId } -> the whole family moves to that team -> { moved }
// A project manager (their team's families) or an admin: { assigneeId } (null:
// nobody) gets every ticket in the family -> { changed }
app.put('/api/ticket-families/:id/assignee', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const assigneeId = req.body?.assigneeId ?? null;
    const changed = await teams.assignFamily(req.scope, String(req.params.id).toUpperCase(), assigneeId);
    console.log(`👥 ${req.user.username} gave family ${req.params.id} (${changed} tickets changed) to user ${assigneeId ?? '(nobody)'}`);
    res.json({ changed });
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Assigning that family');
  }
});

app.put('/api/ticket-families/:id/team', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const moved = await teams.moveFamily(req.scope, String(req.params.id).toUpperCase(), Number(req.body?.teamId));
    console.log(`👥 ${req.user.username} moved family ${req.params.id} (${moved} tickets) to team ${req.body?.teamId}`);
    res.json({ moved });
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Moving that family');
  }
});

// Anyone on a team: { number, status: resolved|closed, note } tells their
// project manager. Only a notification: the ticket itself doesn't change. -> { told }
app.post('/api/tickets/report', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { told } = await teams.reportTicket(req.scope, req.body?.number, req.body?.status, req.body?.note);
    console.log(`👥 ${req.user.username} told ${told.length} project manager(s) they ${req.body?.status} ${req.body?.number}`);
    res.json({ told });
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Telling your project manager');
  }
});

// Resolved or closed (teams.mjs): every team's for admins, a project manager's
// own team's -> { tickets: [{ number, status, by, at, note, team, assignee, type, summary, state }] }
app.get('/api/ticket-statuses', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const list = await teams.ticketStatuses(req.scope);
    const summaries = await ticketSummaries(list.map(t => t.number), req.runQuery);
    res.json({
      tickets: list.map(t => {
        const s = summaries.get(t.number);
        return { ...t, type: s?.type ?? null, summary: s?.summary ?? null, state: s?.state ?? null };
      }),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Loading the resolved and closed tickets');
  }
});

// An admin or the ticket's team's project manager: { status: resolved|closed|open } -> { number, status }
app.put('/api/ticket-statuses/:number', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const done = await teams.setTicketStatus(req.scope, req.params.number, req.body?.status);
    console.log(`✅ ${req.user.username} set ${done.number} to ${done.status}`);
    res.json(done);
  } catch (error) {

});

// Admins, before a presentation: every status undone -> { tickets, notifications }
app.post('/api/ticket-statuses/undo-all', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const done = await teams.undoAllStatuses(req.scope);
    console.log(`✅ ${req.user.username} undid every status: ${done.tickets} tickets, ${done.notifications} notifications`);
    res.json(done);
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Undoing the statuses');

});

// Admins, before a presentation: the demo tickets back on no team, nobody's -> { tickets, families }
app.post('/api/demo-tickets/reset', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const done = await teams.resetDemoTickets(req.scope);
    console.log(`🎬 ${req.user.username} put the ${done.tickets} demo tickets back`);
    res.json(done);
  } catch (error) {
    teamsFailed(res, error, 'Putting the demo tickets back');

});

// =====================================================================
// NOTIFICATIONS (notifications.mjs): the 🔔 in the header
// =====================================================================

// -> { unread, notifications: newest first }
app.get('/api/notifications', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    res.json(await notifications.listNotifications(req.user.id));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('🔔 Loading notifications failed:', error.message);
    res.status(503).json({ error: 'Your notifications could not be loaded right now.' });
  }
});

// { ids } (none: all of them) -> { read }
app.post('/api/notifications/read', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    res.json({ read: await notifications.markRead(req.user.id, req.body?.ids ?? null) });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('🔔 Marking notifications read failed:', error.message);
    res.status(503).json({ error: 'That could not be saved right now.' });
  }
});

// { ids } (some of them) or { upTo } (all of them up to that one) -> { cleared }
app.post('/api/notifications/clear', async (req, res) => {
  const { ids, upTo } = req.body || {};
  const some = Array.isArray(ids) && ids.length > 0;
  if (!some && !Number.isInteger(upTo)) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Say which notifications to clear.' });
  try {
    res.json({ cleared: await notifications.clearNotifications(req.user.id, some ? { ids } : { upTo }) });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('🔔 Clearing notifications failed:', error.message);
    res.status(503).json({ error: 'Your notifications could not be cleared right now.' });
  }
});

// The tables shown in the chat -> a downloadable file (see export.mjs)
app.post('/api/export', async (req, res) => {
  const problem = validateExport(req.body);
  if (problem) return res.status(400).json({ error: problem });

  try {
    const { buffer, fileName, contentType } = await buildExport(req.body);
    console.log(`📥 Export ${req.body.format}: ${fileName} (${buffer.length.toLocaleString()} bytes)`);
    res.attachment(fileName);
    res.type(contentType);
    res.send(buffer);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ExportUnavailableError) {
      return res.status(501).json({ error: error.message });
    }
    console.error('📥 Export failed:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: `Could not create the ${req.body.format.toUpperCase()} file. Please try again.` });
  }
});

app.listen(port, () => {
  console.log(`🚀 Node.js Orchestrator live on port ${port} (model: ${CLAUDE_MODEL})`);
});

// Account setup: create the tables if this is a fresh database, then load the
// shared accounts file (db/accounts.json) so a fresh clone has everyone's
// sign-ins. Retries, because on first start Postgres is still initializing.
async function prepareAccounts(attempt = 1) {
  try {
    await auth.ensureSchema();
    await stars.ensureStarsSchema();
    await seen.ensureSeenSchema();
    await prefs.ensurePrefsSchema();
    await shares.ensureSharesSchema();
    await chats.ensureChatsSchema();
    await teams.ensureTeamsSchema();
    await notifications.ensureNotificationsSchema();
    await issues.ensureIssuesSchema();
  } catch (error) {
    const wait = Math.min(attempt * 2, 15);
    console.error(`🔐 Account database not reachable yet (${error.message}); retrying in ${wait}s`);
    setTimeout(() => prepareAccounts(attempt + 1), wait * 1000).unref();
    return;
  }
  // Notifications go out by email too, once the tables are there (off without a Brevo key)
  startMail();
  try {
    const off = await teams.takeTestAccountsOffTeams();
    if (off) console.log(`👥 Took the test accounts off their teams (${off.people.join(', ')}); ${off.tickets.toLocaleString()} of their tickets are now unassigned`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('👥 Could not take the test accounts off their teams:', error.message);
  }

  const file = process.env.ACCOUNTS_FILE ?? auth.DEFAULT_ACCOUNTS_FILE;
  if (file && existsSync(file)) {
    try {
      const r = await auth.syncAccounts(JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')));
      if (r.added.length || r.updated.length) {
        console.log(`🔐 Loaded ${file}: ${r.added.length} accounts added, ${r.updated.length} updated`);
      }
      if (r.invalid.length) console.warn(`🔐 ${file}: skipped ${r.invalid.join('; ')}`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`🔐 Could not load ${file}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  const users = await auth.listUsers();
  console.log(users.length
    ? `🔐 Account database ready (${users.length} ${users.length === 1 ? 'account' : 'accounts'})`
    : '🔐 Account database ready, but it has no accounts yet. Add one with: docker exec -it analytics_node_app node scripts/users.mjs add <username>');
  seedTeamsWhenReady();
}
prepareAccounts();

// First start with teams: sets them up from every ticket in Cube (teams.mjs).
// Retries, because Cube may still be starting.
async function seedTeamsWhenReady(attempt = 1) {
  try {
    const seeded = await teams.seedTeams(runCubeQuery);
    if (seeded) console.log(`👥 Set up ${seeded.teams} teams: ${seeded.people} people, ${seeded.families.toLocaleString()} families, ${seeded.tickets.toLocaleString()} tickets`);
    // Cube answers: read every ticket's KPI fields now, so the first Home page doesn't wait
    const t0 = Date.now();
    kpis.load(runCubeQuery)
      .then(d => console.log(`📏 KPIs ready: ${d.tickets.size.toLocaleString()} tickets in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`))
      .catch(error => console.error(`📏 Could not read the tickets for KPIs yet (${error.message}); the first page that needs them tries again`));
    // And their summaries, for sorting long lists by any column
    loadTicketIndex(runCubeQuery)
      .then(index => console.log(`↕️  Sorting ready: ${index.size.toLocaleString()} tickets in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`))
      .catch(error => console.error(`↕️  Could not read the tickets for sorting yet (${error.message}); the first sorted list tries again`));
  } catch (error) {
    const wait = Math.min(attempt * 5, 60);
    console.error(`👥 Could not set up the teams yet (${error.message}); retrying in ${wait}s`);
    setTimeout(() => seedTeamsWhenReady(attempt + 1), wait * 1000).unref();
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// NEW TICKETS FROM SERVICENOW: servicenow-sync/ saves each one in the data,
// puts it in a family (teams.placeTicket) and says so on a Postgres channel.
// Who sees what is read again at once; what was read once at start (KPIs,
// the sorting index, families, charts) a little later, once Cube's own
// cache (10 s) has the new rows. Many arrivals together refresh once.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------

const REFRESH_AFTER_MS = 15 * 1000;
let refreshTimer = null;

function ticketsChanged() {
  teams.dataChanged();
  if (refreshTimer) return;
  refreshTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
    refreshTimer = null;
    const t0 = Date.now();
    forgetLinks();
    forgetResults();
    const done = await Promise.allSettled([kpis.reload(runCubeQuery), reloadTicketIndex(runCubeQuery)]);
    const failed = done.filter(d => d.status === 'rejected').map(d => d.reason.message);
    console.log(failed.length ? `🔄 Tickets changed; could not read them all again: ${failed.join('; ')}`
      : `🔄 Tickets changed: KPIs and sorting read again in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`);
  }, REFRESH_AFTER_MS);
}

async function listenForTicketChanges() {
  let client;
  try {
    client = await auth.pool.connect();
    client.on('notification', message => {
      // Only the listener signals here, so this is what 🧊 Architecture reports
      servicenowPush.heard += 1;
      servicenowPush.lastAt = new Date().toISOString();
      servicenowPush.last = message.payload || null;
      ticketsChanged();
    });
    // A dropped connection: listen again
    client.on('error', error => {
      console.error('🔄 Lost the ticket-change channel:', error.message);
      servicenowPush.listening = false;
      client.release(true);
      setTimeout(listenForTicketChanges, 10 * 1000).unref();
    });
    await client.query(`LISTEN ${teams.TICKETS_CHANGED}`);
    servicenowPush.listening = true;
  } catch (error) {
    client?.release(true);
    console.error(`🔄 Could not listen for ticket changes yet (${error.message}); retrying in 10s`);
    setTimeout(listenForTicketChanges, 10 * 1000).unref();
  }
}
listenForTicketChanges();
```

```html
                    💬 Ask<span class="nav-ask-count" id="nav-ask-count" hidden></span>
                </button>
            </form>
        </div>
        <div class="header-right">
            <!-- Anyone signed in: tell the admins something's wrong (notifications.js) -->
            <button type="button" class="header-btn" id="issue-btn" onclick="openIssueDialog()" aria-label="Report a problem" title="Report a problem">🚩</button>
            <button type="button" class="header-btn notify-btn" id="notify-btn" onclick="toggleNotifications()"
                    aria-controls="notify-panel" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Notifications">🔔<span class="notify-count" id="notify-count" hidden></span></button>
            <button type="button" class="header-btn access-btn" onclick="toggleAccessPanel()"
                    aria-controls="access-panel" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Accessibility" title="Accessibility (Alt+A)">♿</button>
            <button type="button" class="header-btn" id="theme-btn" onclick="toggleThemePanel()"
                    aria-controls="theme-panel" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Colors" title="Colors">🎨<span class="header-btn-text"> Colors</span></button>
            <button class="sign-out-btn" type="button" onclick="signOut()">Sign out</button>
        </div>
    </header>

    <!-- 🔔 Notifications: tickets given to you, families moved to your team, members' reports (notifications.js) -->
    <section class="theme-panel notify-panel" id="notify-panel" role="dialog" aria-label="Notifications" hidden>
        <div class="theme-panel-head">
            <span>🔔 Notifications</span>
            <span class="notify-head-actions">
                <button type="button" class="notify-clear-all" id="notify-clear-all" onclick="clearAllNotifications()" hidden>Clear all</button>
                <button type="button" class="drawer-close" onclick="toggleNotifications(false)" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
            </span>
        </div>
        <!-- ✉️ These by email too (mail.mjs), for anyone with an address on file -->
        <div class="notify-email" id="notify-email" hidden>
            <label><input type="checkbox" id="notify-email-on"> ✉️ Email me these too</label>
            <span class="notify-email-to" id="notify-email-to"></span>
        </div>
        <div id="notify-list"></div>
    </section>

    <!-- 🎨 Colors: each person's color scheme, saved to their account (customize.js) -->
    <section class="theme-panel" id="theme-panel" role="dialog" aria-label="Your colors" hidden>
        <div class="theme-panel-head">
            <span>🎨 Your colors</span>
            <button type="button" class="drawer-close" onclick="toggleThemePanel(false)" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
        </div>
        <fieldset>
            <legend>Light or dark</legend>
            <div class="choice-row" id="theme-modes"></div>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset>
            <legend>Accent color <span class="legend-note">buttons, the page you're on, and charts</span></legend>
            <div class="swatch-row">
                <span id="theme-accents" class="swatch-row"></span>
                <label class="swatch swatch-custom" title="Any color you like">
                    <input type="color" id="theme-custom" value="#10a37f" aria-label="Pick any color">
                    <span class="swatch-custom-face">＋</span>
                </label>
            </div>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset>
            <legend>Header</legend>
            <div class="choice-row" id="theme-headers"></div>
        </fieldset>
        <div class="theme-panel-foot">
            <span class="theme-note">Saved to your account, so your colors follow you to any computer.</span>
            <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="resetTheme()">↺ Default colors</button>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ♿ Accessibility: how OneTouch looks, reads aloud and listens, saved to this browser and the account (accessibility.js) -->
    <section class="theme-panel access-panel" id="access-panel" role="dialog" aria-label="Accessibility" hidden>
        <div class="theme-panel-head">
            <span>♿ Accessibility</span>
            <button type="button" class="drawer-close" onclick="toggleAccessPanel(false)" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
        </div>
        <fieldset>
            <legend>Text size</legend>
            <div class="choice-row" id="access-sizes"></div>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset>
            <legend>Seeing the page</legend>
            <div class="access-switches">
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="contrast"><span>High contrast<small>Black on white (white on black in dark mode), with strong lines</small></span></label>
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="readable"><span>Easier-to-read text<small>A plainer typeface, with more space between letters, words and lines</small></span></label>
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="bionic"><span>Bold word beginnings (like Bionic Reading)<small>The first part of every word in bold, so your eyes move from word to word. Screen reader users may prefer it off.</small></span></label>
                <div class="choice-row access-row access-indent" id="access-bionic-levels" aria-label="How much of each word is bold"></div>
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="underline"><span>Underline links and ticket numbers</span></label>
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="focus"><span>Strong focus outline<small>A thick yellow ring around whatever the keyboard is on</small></span></label>
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="cursor"><span>Big mouse pointer</span></label>
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="guide"><span>Reading guide<small>A band across the page that follows the pointer, to keep your place</small></span></label>
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="motion"><span>Less motion<small>No animations or sliding</small></span></label>
            </div>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset>
            <legend>🔍 Magnifier</legend>
            <div class="access-switches">
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="magnifier"><span>Show the text under the pointer, large<small>With the keyboard, the box or button you're on</small></span></label>
            </div>
            <div class="choice-row access-row" id="access-magnify" aria-label="How much larger"></div>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset>
            <legend>🔊 Read aloud</legend>
            <div class="access-switches">
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="selectRead" data-needs="speech"><span>A 🔊 Read button when I select text</span></label>
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="speakAnswers" data-needs="speech"><span>Read Claude's answers to me<small>Every answer also has its own 🔊 Read button</small></span></label>
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="speakHover" data-needs="speech"><span>Read what I point at<small>Rest the pointer on any text for a moment</small></span></label>
            </div>
            <div class="access-row">
                <label for="access-voice">Voice</label>
                <select id="access-voice" data-needs="speech"></select>
            </div>
            <div class="access-row">
                <label for="access-rate">Speed</label>
                <input type="range" id="access-rate" min="0.5" max="2" step="0.1" data-needs="speech">
                <span id="access-rate-value">1.0×</span>
                <button type="button" class="home-action" id="access-try" data-needs="speech">▶ Try it</button>
            </div>
            <p class="access-note warn" id="access-speech-none" hidden>This browser can't read aloud. Edge, Chrome and Safari can.</p>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset>
            <legend>🎤 Speak instead of typing</legend>
            <div class="access-switches">
                <label class="access-switch"><input type="checkbox" data-key="autoSend" data-needs="dictation"><span>Ask Claude as soon as I stop talking<small>In the Ask bar and the chat; otherwise you press Enter</small></span></label>
            </div>
            <p class="access-note">Press 🎤 by the Ask bar or the chat, or <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>M</kbd> in any text box. Your browser turns the speech into text (Edge uses Microsoft's service, Chrome uses Google's), so it needs the internet and your permission for the microphone.</p>
            <p class="access-note warn" id="access-dictation-none" hidden>This browser can't take dictation. Use Edge or Chrome.</p>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset>
            <legend>⌨️ Keyboard shortcuts</legend>
            <ul class="access-keys">
                <li><kbd>/</kbd> the Ask bar</li>
                <li><kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> this panel</li>
                <li><kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd> read aloud what's selected, pointed at or focused (again to stop)</li>
                <li><kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>M</kbd> speak into the text box you're in</li>
                <li><kbd>Esc</kbd> stop reading or listening, close a panel</li>
                <li><kbd>Tab</kbd> first thing on the page: skip to the page itself</li>
            </ul>
        </fieldset>
        <p class="access-status" id="access-status" role="status"></p>
        <div class="theme-panel-foot">
            <span class="theme-note">Kept in this browser and saved to your account.</span>
            <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="resetAccess()">↺ Default settings</button>
        </div>
    </section>

    <main class="app-content" id="main-content" tabindex="-1">
        <!-- HOME: welcome, then each person's sections and charts in their order (customize.js) -->
        <section id="home-view" class="view-panel active">
            <div class="home" id="home">
                <div class="home-head">
                    <h2 class="home-welcome" id="home-welcome">Welcome!</h2>
                    <div class="home-head-actions">
                        <button type="button" class="home-action" id="tour-btn" onclick="startTour()" title="A short tour of OneTouch">❔ Tour</button>
                        <button type="button" class="home-action" id="customize-home-btn" onclick="toggleHomeEditing()" aria-pressed="false">✏️ Customize Home</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <!-- While customizing: add charts, bring back hidden sections, reset -->
                <div class="home-edit-bar" id="home-edit-bar" hidden>
                    <p class="home-edit-text"><b>Customizing Home.</b> Move or hide sections with their buttons, add charts of your own,
                        and edit or move a chart with the buttons on it. Changes are saved to your account as you go.</p>
                    <div class="home-edit-actions">
                        <button type="button" class="primary-btn" onclick="addHomeChart()">＋ Add a chart</button>
                        <span class="home-add-back" id="home-add-back"></span>
                        <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="resetHomeLayout()">↺ Reset Home</button>
                        <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="toggleHomeEditing(false)">✓ Done</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <p class="home-status home-empty" id="home-empty" hidden>Your Home page is empty. Click <b>Customize Home</b> to add sections or charts.</p>

                <div class="home-blocks waiting" id="home-blocks">
                    <!-- Your tickets: the ones assigned to you (as a list and in charts), Ticket results and starred tickets -->
                    <section class="home-block" data-block="tickets">
                        <div class="home-modes" role="tablist" aria-label="Your tickets">
                            <button type="button" role="tab" class="home-mode active" data-mode="assigned" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="home-assigned" onclick="setHomeMode('assigned')">
                                <span class="home-mode-name">📋 Assigned to me <span class="star-count" id="assigned-count" hidden>0</span></span>
                                <span class="home-mode-desc">Highest priority first, then oldest</span>
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" role="tab" class="home-mode" data-mode="charts" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="home-charts" onclick="setHomeMode('charts')">
                                <span class="home-mode-name">📊 My charts</span>
                                <span class="home-mode-desc">The tickets assigned to you, in charts</span>
                            </button>
                            <!-- Project managers and admins: their team's families and each one's KPIs -->
                            <button type="button" role="tab" class="home-mode" data-mode="families" id="kpi-families-tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="home-families" onclick="setHomeMode('families')" hidden>
                                <span class="home-mode-name">👪 Team families <span class="star-count" id="kpi-families-count" hidden>0</span></span>
                                <span class="home-mode-desc">Each family's KPIs, the most urgent first</span>
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" role="tab" class="home-mode" data-mode="results" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="home-results" onclick="setHomeMode('results')">
                                <span class="home-mode-name">🎫 Ticket results</span>
                                <span class="home-mode-desc">Every ticket the AI assistant has shown you</span>
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" role="tab" class="home-mode" data-mode="starred" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="home-starred" onclick="setHomeMode('starred')">
                                <span class="home-mode-name">★ Starred tickets <span class="star-count" id="star-count">0</span></span>
                                <span class="home-mode-desc">Saved to your account</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <div class="home-panel" id="home-assigned" role="tabpanel">
                            <div class="home-result" id="assigned-result" aria-live="polite"></div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="home-panel" id="home-charts" role="tabpanel" hidden>
                            <div class="home-result" id="my-charts-result"></div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="home-panel" id="home-families" role="tabpanel" hidden>
                            <div class="home-result" id="kpi-families-result" aria-live="polite"></div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="home-panel" id="home-results" role="tabpanel" hidden>
                            <div class="home-result" id="ticket-results" aria-live="polite"></div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="home-panel" id="home-starred" role="tabpanel" hidden>
                            <div class="home-result" id="starred-result" aria-live="polite"></div>
                        </div>
                    </section>

                    <!-- Your dashboards: shortcuts to the dashboards you built (hidden until added) -->
                    <section class="home-block" data-block="shortcuts" hidden>
                        <div class="guide-card shortcuts-card">
                            <span class="guide-title">📊 Your dashboards</span>
                            <div class="shortcut-list" id="home-shortcuts"></div>
                        </div>
                    </section>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <!-- TEAM: teams, their people and roles, and who has which ticket (teams.js) -->
        <section id="teams-view" class="view-panel">
            <div class="home teams" id="teams"></div>
        </section>

        <!-- ARCHITECTURE: the 3D map of how OneTouch is built, admins only (architecture.js) -->
        <section id="architecture-view" class="view-panel">
            <div class="arch" id="architecture"></div>
        </section>

        <!-- DASHBOARD VIEW CONTAINER (METABASE, and each person's own dashboards) -->
        <section id="dashboard-view" class="view-panel">
            <div class="dashboard-container">
                <!-- Top-left: the drawer button and which dashboard is showing -->
                <div class="dashboard-toolbar">
                    <button type="button" class="drawer-toggle" id="dashboard-drawer-toggle"
                            aria-controls="dashboard-drawer" aria-expanded="false" onclick="toggleDashboardDrawer()">
                        <span aria-hidden="true">☰</span> Dashboards
                    </button>
                    <!-- Shown on the detail pages a click opens -->
                    <button type="button" class="dashboard-back" id="dashboard-back" hidden onclick="dashboardBack()">← Back</button>
                    <div class="dashboard-current">
                        <span class="dashboard-current-group" id="dashboard-current-group"></span>
                        <span class="dashboard-current-name" id="dashboard-current-name"></span>
                        <span class="dashboard-current-desc" id="dashboard-current-desc"></span>
                    </div>
                    <!-- On an incident, change or request record: star it -->
                    <button type="button" class="star-btn labelled" id="dashboard-star" hidden></button>
                    <span class="dashboard-hint" id="dashboard-hint" hidden>Click a bar, slice, number or blue value for details</span>
                    <button type="button" class="home-action dashboard-tour-btn" id="dashboard-tour-btn" onclick="startTour('dashboards')"
                            title="A short tour of the Dashboards page" aria-label="Tour of the Dashboards page">❔<span class="tour-btn-word"> Tour</span></button>
                </div>
                <div class="dashboard-body">
                    <div class="dashboard-backdrop" id="dashboard-backdrop" onclick="toggleDashboardDrawer(false)"></div>
                    <aside class="dashboard-drawer" id="dashboard-drawer" aria-label="Dashboards">
                        <div class="drawer-header">
                            <span>Dashboards</span>
                            <button type="button" class="drawer-close" onclick="toggleDashboardDrawer(false)" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
                        </div>
                        <!-- Pages built into OneTouch itself (families.js) -->
                        <section class="drawer-group builtin-dashboards">
                            <h3>Built into OneTouch</h3>
                            <button type="button" class="dashboard-choice" data-builtin="families" onclick="showFamilies(); toggleDashboardDrawer(false)">
                                <span class="dashboard-choice-name">👪 Ticket families</span>
                                <span class="dashboard-choice-desc">Parent tickets and their children. Click any ticket, parent or child, to open it.</span>
                            </button>
                        </section>
                        <!-- The dashboards this person built (customize.js) -->
                        <section class="drawer-group my-dashboards">
                            <h3>My dashboards</h3>
                            <div id="my-dashboards-list"></div>
                            <button type="button" class="drawer-new" onclick="newBoard()">＋ New dashboard</button>
                        </section>
                        <!-- The team dashboards: filled in by app.js from /api/dashboards (built by scripts/metabase-setup.mjs) -->
                        <nav id="dashboard-picker"></nav>
                        <div class="drawer-foot">
                            <p class="drawer-note" id="drawer-hidden-note"></p>
                            <button type="button" class="drawer-customize" id="drawer-customize" onclick="toggleDrawerEditing()" aria-pressed="false">👁 Show or hide team dashboards</button>
                        </div>
                    </aside>
                    <p class="dashboard-message" id="dashboard-message">Loading dashboards…</p>
                    <!-- On an incident, change or request record: its family (families.js) -->
                    <section class="record-family" id="record-family" aria-label="Parent, children and other linked tickets" hidden>
                        <div class="record-family-head">
                            <p class="record-family-summary" id="record-family-summary"></p>
                            <button type="button" class="home-action" id="record-family-toggle" aria-controls="record-family-body" hidden></button>
                        </div>
                        <div class="record-family-body" id="record-family-body"></div>
                    </section>
                    <iframe id="dashboard-frame" title="Dashboard" hidden></iframe>
                    <!-- 👪 Ticket families (families.js): every family of one kind, biggest first -->
                    <div class="families-view" id="families-view" hidden>
                        <div class="families-kinds" id="families-kinds" role="group" aria-label="Kind of family"></div>
                        <div class="families-tools">
                            <form class="families-find" id="families-find" role="search">
                                <input type="search" id="families-q" placeholder="Find a ticket's families: INC1813970, RITM0440458…" aria-label="Ticket number">
                                <button type="submit" class="primary-btn">Find</button>
                            </form>
                        </div>
                        <div id="families-list"></div>
                    </div>
                    <!-- One of this person's own dashboards -->
                    <div class="board-view" id="board-view" hidden>
                        <div class="board-bar">
                            <button type="button" class="primary-btn" onclick="addBoardChart()">＋ Add a chart</button>
                            <button type="button" class="home-action" id="board-share-btn" onclick="shareCurrentBoard()">🔗 Share</button>
                            <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="renameBoard()">✎ Rename</button>
                            <button type="button" class="home-action danger" onclick="deleteBoard()">🗑 Delete dashboard</button>
                        </div>
                        <!-- Filters for every chart on the dashboard (saved with it) -->
                        <div class="board-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filters for every chart on this dashboard">
                            <span class="board-filters-label">Every chart:</span>
                            <label class="board-filter">Opened <select id="bf-dates"></select></label>
                            <span class="board-filter" id="bf-range" hidden>
                                <input type="date" id="bf-from" aria-label="Opened from"> to <input type="date" id="bf-to" aria-label="Opened to">
                            </span>
                            <div class="team-picker">
                                <button type="button" class="home-action" id="bf-team-btn" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="bf-team-pop">Team: any ▾</button>
                                <div class="team-pop" id="bf-team-pop" hidden>
                                    <input type="search" id="bf-team-search" placeholder="Search teams…" aria-label="Search teams">
                                    <div class="filter-values" id="bf-team-list"></div>
                                    <p class="team-pop-note">Requests have no team, so their charts ignore this.</p>
                                    <div class="team-pop-foot">
                                        <button type="button" class="home-action" id="bf-team-clear">Any team</button>
                                        <button type="button" class="primary-btn" id="bf-team-done">Done</button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <button type="button" class="home-action" id="bf-clear" hidden>✕ Clear filters</button>
                        </div>
                        <div class="tile-grid" id="board-grid"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <!-- AI ASSISTANT, opened from the Ask bar in the header; floats over any page, and a click outside it closes it -->
        <div class="assistant-backdrop" id="assistant-backdrop" onclick="toggleAssistant(false)"></div>
        <section class="assistant-panel" id="assistant-panel" aria-label="AI Assistant">
            <div class="assistant-head">
                <span class="assistant-title">💬 AI Assistant</span>
                <div class="assistant-head-actions">
                    <button type="button" class="assistant-minimize" id="chat-history-btn" onclick="toggleChatHistory()" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="chat-history" title="Your saved chats: open one to see it again and carry on where you left off">Chat History</button>
                    <button type="button" class="assistant-delete" onclick="deleteChat()" title="Delete this conversation: its questions and answers disappear, it leaves Chat History, and the assistant forgets it">🗑 Delete chat</button>
                    <button type="button" class="assistant-minimize" onclick="toggleAssistant(false)" title="Close the chat (the conversation is kept; the Ask bar at the top brings it back)">Minimize ▴</button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="chat-container">
                <!-- Chat History, over the conversation until one is opened -->
                <div class="chat-history" id="chat-history" hidden>
                    <div class="chat-history-head">
                        <span>Chat History</span>
                        <button type="button" class="drawer-close" onclick="toggleChatHistory(false)" aria-label="Close chat history">✕</button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="chat-history-list" id="chat-history-list"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="chat-messages" id="chat-log">
                    <div class="msg system-msg" id="welcome-msg">Hello!</div>
                </div>
                <div class="chat-input-area">
                    <input type="text" id="user-prompt" placeholder="Ask a data question..." aria-label="Ask a data question" onkeydown="if(event.key === 'Enter') sendPrompt()">
                    <button type="button" class="mic-btn" data-mic-for="user-prompt" aria-pressed="false"
                            aria-label="Speak your question" title="Speak your question (Alt+M)">🎤</button>
                    <button id="send-btn" onclick="sendPrompt()">Ask Claude</button>
                    <button id="new-chat-btn" type="button" onclick="newChat()" title="Start a fresh chat (this one is kept under Chat History)">New chat</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
    </main>

    <!-- THE CHART BUILDER: what a chart counts, which ones, grouped by what, and how it's drawn -->
    <dialog class="builder" id="chart-builder" aria-labelledby="builder-title">
        <form id="builder-form" class="builder-form">
            <div class="builder-head">
                <h2 id="builder-title">Add a chart</h2>
                <button type="button" class="drawer-close" onclick="closeBuilder()" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="builder-body">
                <div class="builder-fields">
                    <p class="builder-note" id="b-note" hidden></p>
                    <fieldset>
                        <legend>1. What to count</legend>
                        <select id="b-source" aria-label="What to count"></select>
                    </fieldset>
                    <fieldset>
                        <legend>2. Which ones</legend>
                        <div class="choice-row" id="b-status" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Open or closed"></div>
                        <p class="field-note" id="b-status-note"></p>
                        <label class="field-label">Opened
                            <select id="b-dates"></select>
                        </label>
                        <div class="date-range" id="b-range" hidden>
                            <label>From <input type="date" id="b-from"></label>
                            <label>To <input type="date" id="b-to"></label>
                        </div>
                        <p class="field-note" id="b-dates-note"></p>
                        <div id="b-filters"></div>
                        <button type="button" class="home-action" id="b-add-filter">＋ Only include some… (team, priority, state, …)</button>
                    </fieldset>
                    <fieldset>
                        <legend>3. Group by</legend>
                        <select id="b-group" aria-label="Group by"></select>
                    </fieldset>
                    <fieldset>
                        <legend>4. Show it as</legend>
                        <div class="display-picker" id="b-display" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Chart type"></div>
                        <p class="field-note" id="b-display-note"></p>
                        <div class="builder-row" id="b-cut">
                            <label class="field-label" id="b-limit-wrap">Show
                                <select id="b-limit"></select>
                            </label>
                            <!-- Ascending or descending, by count or by the groups (customize.js paintDisplay) -->
                            <label class="field-label">Order
                                <select id="b-sort"></select>
                            </label>
                        </div>
                        <div class="builder-row" id="b-color-row">
                            <span class="field-label-text">Color</span>
                            <div class="swatch-row" id="b-colors" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Color"></div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="builder-row">
                            <span class="field-label-text">Size</span>
                            <div class="choice-row" id="b-sizes" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Size"></div>
                        </div>
                    </fieldset>
                    <fieldset>
                        <legend>5. Title</legend>
                        <input type="text" id="b-title" maxlength="80" aria-label="Title">
                    </fieldset>
                </div>
                <div class="builder-preview">
                    <div class="builder-preview-label">Preview</div>
                    <div id="b-preview"></div>
                    <p class="field-note" id="b-scope-note" hidden></p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="builder-foot">
                <label class="builder-dest" id="b-dest-row" hidden>Save to <select id="b-dest"></select></label>
                <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="closeBuilder()">Cancel</button>
                <button type="submit" class="primary-btn" id="b-save">Add chart</button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </dialog>

    <!-- A small "name it" box (new dashboard, rename) -->
    <dialog class="ask-dialog" id="ask-dialog">
        <form method="dialog">
            <h2 class="ask-title"></h2>
            <label class="field-label"><span class="ask-label"></span>
                <input type="text" id="ask-input" maxlength="60" required>
            </label>
            <div class="builder-foot">
                <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="this.closest('dialog').close('cancel')">Cancel</button>
                <button type="submit" class="primary-btn" id="ask-ok" value="ok">Save</button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </dialog>

    <!-- Telling your project manager you resolved or closed a ticket (notifications.js) -->
    <dialog class="ask-dialog report-dialog" id="report-dialog" aria-labelledby="report-title">
        <form method="dialog">
            <h2 id="report-title">Tell your project manager</h2>
            <p class="report-ticket" id="report-ticket"></p>
            <label class="field-label">What did you do?
                <select id="report-status">
                    <option value="resolved">I resolved it</option>
                    <option value="closed">I closed it</option>
                </select>
            </label>
            <label class="field-label">Note (optional)
                <textarea id="report-note" rows="3" maxlength="500" placeholder="e.g. Restarted the service; the user confirmed it works"></textarea>
            </label>
            <p class="theme-note report-hint">This only sends your project manager a notification. The ticket itself doesn't change in OneTouch.</p>
            <p class="home-status error" id="report-error" role="alert" hidden></p>
            <div class="builder-foot">
                <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="this.closest('dialog').close('cancel')">Cancel</button>
                <button type="submit" class="primary-btn" id="report-send" value="ok">Send</button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </dialog>

    <!-- Reporting a problem to the admins (notifications.js, issues.mjs) -->
    <dialog class="ask-dialog report-dialog" id="issue-dialog" aria-labelledby="issue-title">
        <form method="dialog">
            <h2 id="issue-title">🚩 Report a problem</h2>
            <p class="report-ticket">Tell the admins what went wrong. They get a notification and an email straight away.</p>
            <label class="field-label">What kind of problem is it?
                <select id="issue-category">
                    <option value="broken">Something isn't working</option>
                    <option value="data">The data looks wrong</option>
                    <option value="access">I can't see or do something I should</option>
                    <option value="slow">It's very slow</option>
                    <option value="other">Something else</option>
                </select>
            </label>
            <label class="field-label">What happened?
                <textarea id="issue-message" rows="5" maxlength="2000" required placeholder="e.g. The Incidents dashboard stays blank since this morning"></textarea>
            </label>
            <p class="theme-note report-hint">Sent with your name, the page you're on and your browser. Please leave out passwords. What you write stays in OneTouch: the email only says what kind of problem it is.</p>
            <p class="home-status error" id="issue-error" role="alert" hidden></p>
            <div class="builder-foot">
                <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="this.closest('dialog').close('cancel')">Cancel</button>
                <button type="submit" class="primary-btn" id="issue-send" value="ok">Send to the admins</button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </dialog>

    <!-- The tickets behind a bar, slice, point or number of a chart -->
    <dialog class="builder drill-dialog" id="drill-dialog" aria-labelledby="drill-title">
        <div class="builder-head">
            <h2 id="drill-title"></h2>
            <button type="button" class="drawer-close" onclick="this.closest('dialog').close()" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div class="drill-body" id="drill-body"></div>
    </dialog>

    <!-- One ticket over the page: its family first, then its record (families.js) -->
    <dialog class="builder ticket-dialog" id="ticket-dialog" aria-labelledby="ticket-dialog-title">
        <div class="builder-head">
            <div class="ticket-dialog-nav">
                <button type="button" class="home-action" id="ticket-dialog-back" onclick="ticketDialogBack()" hidden>← Back</button>
                <h2 id="ticket-dialog-title"></h2>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="drawer-close" onclick="this.closest('dialog').close()" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div class="drill-body" id="ticket-dialog-body"></div>
    </dialog>

    <!-- Sharing one of your dashboards: its link -->
    <dialog class="ask-dialog share-dialog" id="share-dialog" aria-labelledby="share-title">
        <h2 id="share-title">Share this dashboard</h2>
        <p class="share-text">Anyone who signs in to OneTouch can open this link, see the dashboard, and add a copy to
            their own dashboards. When you change the dashboard, the link shows the change; copies people already added stay as they were.</p>
        <div class="share-link">
            <input type="text" id="share-link" readonly aria-label="Link to the dashboard">
            <button type="button" class="primary-btn" onclick="copyShareLink()">Copy link</button>
        </div>
        <div class="builder-foot">
            <button type="button" class="home-action danger" id="share-stop">Stop sharing</button>
            <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="this.closest('dialog').close()">Done</button>
        </div>
    </dialog>

    <!-- A dashboard someone shared with you (opened from its link) -->
    <dialog class="builder shared-dialog" id="shared-dialog" aria-labelledby="shared-title">
        <div class="builder-head">
            <h2 id="shared-title"></h2>
            <button type="button" class="drawer-close" onclick="this.closest('dialog').close()" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div class="shared-body">
            <p class="home-status" id="shared-about"></p>
            <div class="tile-grid" id="shared-grid"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="builder-foot">
            <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="this.closest('dialog').close()">Close</button>
            <button type="button" class="primary-btn" id="shared-add">＋ Add to my dashboards</button>
        </div>
    </dialog>

    <!-- The tour: a spotlight on one part of the page, and what it does -->
    <div class="tour" id="tour" hidden>
        <div class="tour-blocker"></div>
        <div class="tour-spot" id="tour-spot"></div>
        <div class="tour-card" id="tour-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="tour-title" aria-describedby="tour-text">
            <div class="tour-step" id="tour-step"></div>
            <h2 id="tour-title"></h2>
            <p id="tour-text"></p>
            <div class="tour-actions">
                <button type="button" class="home-action" onclick="closeTour()">Skip the tour</button>
                <span class="tour-spacer"></span>
                <button type="button" class="home-action" id="tour-back" onclick="tourMove(-1)">Back</button>
                <button type="button" class="primary-btn" id="tour-next" onclick="tourMove(1)">Next</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script src="sorting.js"></script>
    <script src="lookup.js"></script>
    <script src="picker.js"></script>
    <script src="charts.js"></script>
    <script src="customize.js"></script>
    <script src="families.js"></script>
    <script src="teams.js"></script>
    <script src="notifications.js"></script>
    <script src="accessibility.js"></script>
    <script src="architecture.js"></script>
    <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

### B.26 `public/style.css`

```css
/* COLORS: every color in the app is one of these, so each person's color
   scheme (light / dark, accent, header; see customize.js) changes them all.
   --accent and --on-accent are set by the page from the chosen accent. */
:root {
    color-scheme: light;
    --bg-primary: #f4f6f9;
    --panel-bg: #ffffff;
    --surface-2: #f7fafc;
    --surface-3: #edf2f7;
    --zebra: #f9fafb;
    --text: #2d3748;
    --text-2: #4a5568;
    --muted: #718096;
    --faint: #a0aec0;
    --border: #e2e8f0;
    --accent: #10a37f;
    --on-accent: #ffffff;
    --accent-ink: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, #000);
    --accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, var(--panel-bg));
    --accent-softer: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, var(--panel-bg));
    --link: #2b6cb0;
    --danger: #c53030;
    --danger-soft: #fff5f5;
    --danger-line: #feb2b2;
    --warn: #d69e2e;
    --warn-ink: #975a16;
    --warn-soft: #fefcbf;
    --warn-soft-hover: #faf089;
    --warn-softer: #fffff0;
    --warn-line: #ecc94b;
    --info: #4299e1;
    --info-soft: #ebf8ff;
    --same-bg: #e6fffa;
    --same-ink: #0b7a5f;
    --differ-bg: #fffaf0;
    --differ-ink: #b7791f;
    --note-bg: #fffbea;
    --backdrop: rgba(26, 32, 44, 0.35);
    --shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
    --shadow-strong: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
    --toast-bg: #1a202c;
    --toast-text: #ffffff;
    /* The header (dark by default; see the data-header variants below) */
    --header-bg: #1a202c;
    --header-text: #cbd5e0;
    --header-strong: #ffffff;
    --header-line: #4a5568;
    --header-line-hover: #a0aec0;
    --header-link-hover: #c6f6e5;
    /* Charts: hairline grid and axis, and the categorical colors in their
       fixed order (validated for color-blind separation on this surface) */
    --chart-grid: #edf0f3;
    --chart-axis: #cbd2d9;
    --chart-other: #a0aec0;
    --series-1: #2a78d6;
    --series-2: #eb6834;
    --series-3: #1baf7a;
    --series-4: #eda100;
    --series-5: #e87ba4;
    --series-6: #008300;
    --series-7: #6250d6;
    --series-8: #e34948;
}

/* Dark mode: its own steps, not an automatic flip */
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --bg-primary: #0f1216;
    --panel-bg: #191c21;
    --surface-2: #1f2329;
    --surface-3: #262b32;
    --zebra: #1c2025;
    --text: #e4e7eb;
    --text-2: #c2c8d0;
    --muted: #9aa3ae;
    --faint: #6f7883;
    --border: #2e343c;
    --accent-ink: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, #fff);
    --accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 24%, var(--panel-bg));
    --accent-softer: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, var(--panel-bg));
    --link: #63b3ed;
    --danger: #fc8181;
    --danger-soft: #3b1f22;
    --danger-line: #7b3437;
    --warn: #ecc94b;
    --warn-ink: #f6e05e;
    --warn-soft: #3d3514;
    --warn-soft-hover: #4d4318;
    --warn-softer: #2a2510;
    --warn-line: #8a7425;
    --info: #63b3ed;
    --info-soft: #1a2c3d;
    --same-bg: #133b33;
    --same-ink: #68d3b0;
    --differ-bg: #3a2b14;
    --differ-ink: #f0b866;
    --note-bg: #2f2a16;
    --backdrop: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    --shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    --shadow-strong: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    --toast-bg: #e4e7eb;
    --toast-text: #1a202c;
    --header-bg: #0b0d10;
    --header-line: #2e343c;
    --header-line-hover: #6f7883;
    --chart-grid: #262b32;
    --chart-axis: #3a414a;
    --chart-other: #6f7883;
    --series-1: #3987e5;
    --series-2: #d95926;
    --series-3: #199e70;
    --series-4: #c98500;
    --series-5: #d55181;
    --series-6: #008300;
    --series-7: #9085e9;
    --series-8: #e66767;
}

/* Header in the accent color */
:root[data-header="accent"] {
    --header-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 82%, #000);
    --header-text: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    --header-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
    --header-line-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    --header-link-hover: #ffffff;
}
/* Header in the page's own colors */
:root[data-header="light"] {
    --header-bg: var(--panel-bg);
    --header-text: var(--text-2);
    --header-strong: var(--text);
    --header-line: var(--border);
    --header-line-hover: var(--faint);
    --header-link-hover: var(--accent);
}

body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    background-color: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
}

.app-header {
    background: var(--header-bg);
    color: var(--header-strong);
    padding: 10px 20px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
}
:root[data-header="light"] .app-header { border-bottom-color: var(--border); }

.app-header h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; }
.app-title { display: flex; align-items: center; }
/* The logo and "OneTouch": a button back to Home */
.home-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 2px 4px 2px 0;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
}
/* Only with a mouse: on touch screens a tapped link would keep its hover color */
@media (hover: hover) {
    .home-link:hover { color: var(--header-link-hover); }
}
.home-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.app-logo { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; }
/* Signed-in person's name, next to the OneTouch title */
.user-name {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--header-text);
    padding-left: 10px;
    margin-left: 2px;
    border-left: 1px solid var(--header-line);
}
.user-name:empty { display: none; }

/* Top left, one row: logo and name (Home), who's signed in, then Home and Dashboards */
.header-left { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 12px; min-width: 0; }
.tab-navigation { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.tab-navigation .tab-btn,
.header-btn,
.sign-out-btn {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--header-line);
    border-radius: 6px;
    color: var(--header-text);
    padding: 5px 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.tab-navigation .tab-btn:hover,
.header-btn:hover,
.sign-out-btn:hover { color: var(--header-strong); border-color: var(--header-line-hover); }
.sign-out-btn { flex-shrink: 0; }
.header-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* The Ask bar, right of the page buttons: a question for the AI assistant from any page */
.nav-ask { display: flex; align-items: stretch; min-width: 0; }
.nav-ask input {
    width: clamp(170px, 24vw, 360px);
    min-width: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--header-line);
    border-right: none;
    border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--header-strong) 7%, transparent);
    color: var(--header-strong);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}
.nav-ask input::placeholder { color: var(--header-text); }
.nav-ask input:hover { border-color: var(--header-line-hover); }
.nav-ask input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -1px; border-color: var(--accent); }
.nav-ask-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 5px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--accent);
    border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--on-accent);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.nav-ask-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }
.nav-ask-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--header-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }
/* How many questions the open chat has */
.nav-ask-count {
    min-width: 18px;
    padding: 0 5px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-accent) 25%, transparent);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    line-height: 18px;
    text-align: center;
}
.nav-ask-count[hidden] { display: none; }
/* On a header that is itself the accent color: a white button, and a white focus ring */
:root[data-header="accent"] .nav-ask-btn { background: #ffffff; border-color: #ffffff; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, #000); }
:root[data-header="accent"] .nav-ask-count { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, #fff); }
:root[data-header="accent"] .nav-ask input:focus { outline-color: #ffffff; border-color: #ffffff; }
.header-btn[aria-expanded="true"] { color: var(--header-strong); border-color: var(--header-line-hover); }

/* The page that's showing (Home or Dashboards) lights up in the accent color */
.tab-navigation .tab-btn.active {
    color: var(--on-accent);
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}
/* On a header that is itself the accent color, the lit button stands out in white */
:root[data-header="accent"] .tab-navigation .tab-btn.active {
    color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, #000);
    background: #ffffff;
    border-color: #ffffff;
}

.app-content { flex: 1; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }

.view-panel {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

.view-panel.active { display: flex; }


/* The full conversation, dropped down over whichever page is showing */
.assistant-backdrop {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: var(--backdrop);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
    z-index: 10;
}
.assistant-backdrop.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.assistant-panel {
    position: absolute;
    top: 12px;
    bottom: 16px;
    left: 50%;
    width: min(1200px, calc(100% - 32px));
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 40px var(--shadow-strong);
    overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 11;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, -12px);
    visibility: hidden;
    /* Hidden only after the fade, but visible (and focusable) at once on open */
    transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s, visibility 0s linear 0.15s;
}
.assistant-panel.open {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, 0);
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s, visibility 0s;
}
.assistant-head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-weight: 700;
}
.assistant-head-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.assistant-minimize,
.assistant-delete {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 12px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.assistant-minimize:hover { background: var(--bg-primary); }
.assistant-delete { color: var(--danger); }
.assistant-delete:hover { background: var(--danger-soft); border-color: var(--danger-line); }
.assistant-panel .chat-container {
    position: relative;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    max-width: none;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0;
}
.assistant-minimize[aria-expanded="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); }

/* Chat History: a list over the conversation */
.chat-history {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
}
.chat-history[hidden] { display: none; }
.chat-history-head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-weight: 700;
}
.chat-history-list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 12px 20px; }
.chat-history-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 6px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.chat-history-item.current { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-softer); }
.chat-history-open {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    text-align: left;
    color: var(--text);
    cursor: pointer;
    font: inherit;
}
.chat-history-open:hover { background: var(--bg-primary); }
.chat-history-title { font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.chat-history-meta { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.chat-history-delete {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    padding: 0 12px;
    color: var(--danger);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.chat-history-delete:hover { background: var(--danger-soft); }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
    .app-header { padding: 10px 16px; }
}
/* A phone or a narrow window: the header stacks, so nothing slides under 🔔,
   🎨 and Sign out. On top the logo and those buttons (the name between them
   while there's room), then the page buttons, then the Ask bar across the
   whole width. The left side's pieces join the header's own rows. */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
    .app-header { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; }
    .header-left { display: contents; }
    .app-title { order: 1; }
    .user-name { order: 2; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .header-right { order: 3; margin-left: auto; }
    .tab-navigation { order: 4; flex: 1 1 100%; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .nav-ask { order: 5; flex: 1 1 100%; }
    .nav-ask input { width: auto; flex: 1 1 auto; }
}
/* A phone: no room for the name on top, and 🎨 without its word */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .user-name { display: none; }
    .header-btn-text { display: none; }
    .tab-navigation .tab-btn, .header-btn, .sign-out-btn { padding: 5px 9px; }
}
/* The smallest phones (320 px): a little tighter, so it's still three rows */
@media (max-width: 359px) {
    .app-header { padding: 8px 12px; }
    .app-header h1 { font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .tab-navigation, .header-right { gap: 6px; }
    .tab-navigation .tab-btn, .header-btn, .sign-out-btn { padding: 5px 7px; }
}

/* HOME PAGE: the welcome sits in the page's top-left corner */
#home-view { overflow-y: auto; }

/* TEAM TAB (teams.js): teams, their people, and who has which ticket */
#teams-view { overflow-y: auto; }
.tab-btn[hidden] { display: none; }
.teams > .home-status { max-width: 820px; }
.team-picker { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 4px 0 16px; }
.team-pick {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: var(--text);
    cursor: pointer;
    font: inherit;
}
.team-pick:hover { background: var(--bg-primary); }
.team-pick.active { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-softer); }
.team-pick-name { font-weight: 700; }
.team-pick-meta { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.team-card {
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.team-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; }
.team-table td.num, .team-table th.num { text-align: right; }
.team-table select, .team-filters select, .team-bulk select { max-width: 100%; }
.team-you td { font-weight: 600; }
.team-you-tag { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 6px; }
.team-unassigned td { color: var(--text-2); font-style: italic; }
.team-test-tag { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--warn-ink); background: var(--warn-soft); border: 1px solid var(--warn-line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 6px; vertical-align: middle; }
.team-member-team { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.team-member-team .home-action { white-space: nowrap; }
.team-filters, .team-bulk, .team-pager { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; margin: 8px 0; }
.team-filters label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.87rem; }
.team-filters input, .team-filters select, .team-bulk select, .team-table select, .family-group-do select, .person-input {
    padding: 5px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.87rem;
}

/* A name typed to give tickets or a family (picker.js). The list of matches
   floats over the page (fixed, placed by the script), so table scroll boxes
   don't cut it off. */
.person-picker { display: inline-block; min-width: 190px; max-width: 100%; }
.person-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }
.person-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -1px; border-color: var(--accent); }
.person-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
.person-options {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 60;
    max-height: 280px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 4px;
    list-style: none;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px var(--shadow-strong);
    font-size: 0.87rem;
}
.person-option { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; }
.person-option:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
.person-option[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.person-name { color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; }
.person-name mark { background: none; color: var(--accent-ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
.person-meta { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 0.78rem; }
.person-empty { padding: 6px 10px; color: var(--text-2); font-style: italic; }
.team-bulk { font-size: 0.87rem; }
.team-pager { justify-content: flex-end; font-size: 0.87rem; color: var(--text-2); }
/* Admins' "Not assigned yet" (teams.js): its button says when tickets are
   waiting, and a row for each family heads that family's tickets */
.team-pick-nobody.waiting .team-pick-meta { color: var(--warn-ink); font-weight: 600; }
.result-table tbody tr.family-group,
.result-table tbody tr.family-group:nth-child(even),
.result-table tbody tr.family-group:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
.family-group td { border-top: 2px solid var(--border); }
.family-group-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px 16px; }
.family-group-what { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.family-group-meta { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.family-group-do { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 10px; font-size: 0.87rem; }
.family-group-do label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.family-group-do select { max-width: 100%; }
.home-action:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }
.link-btn { background: none; border: none; padding: 0; color: var(--link); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; text-decoration: underline; }
.result-visibility { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.home {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1400px;
    padding: 24px 24px 40px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
.home-welcome { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 1.6rem; }

/* A card on Home (Your dashboards) */
.guide-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
}
.guide-title { font-weight: 700; }
.home-action.danger { color: var(--danger); }

/* 🔍 Looking up a list's tickets by any of its columns (lookup.js) */
.lookup-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 10px; margin: 8px 0; font-size: 0.87rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.lookup-icon { font-size: 0.9rem; }
.lookup-input {
    flex: 0 1 320px;
    min-width: 160px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font: inherit;
}
.lookup-input:focus, .lookup-col:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -1px; border-color: var(--accent); }
.lookup-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
```
