### B.78 `checks/ticket-order.mjs`

```js
// Assigned to me's order, checked against tickets made up here (no Cube, no
// database, no API key): most urgent first, a change's risk standing in for
// a priority, requests and tasks last, and the oldest first within each.
//
//   npm test        (CI runs it on every push)
//
// Exits non-zero on the first wrong answer.

import { ticketsByPriority, sortRows } from '../tickets.mjs';

// cube -> its rows, with the columns tickets.mjs asks for
const DATA = {
  incident: [
    { number: 'INC0000001', priority: 'P3 - Moderate', state: 'In Progress', created: '2026-07-10' },
    { number: 'INC0000002', priority: 'P1 - Critical', state: 'New', created: '2026-08-01' },
    { number: 'INC0000003', priority: 'P1 - Critical', state: 'Closed', created: '2026-07-05' },
    { number: 'INC0000004', priority: 'P4 - Low', state: 'New', created: '2026-07-12' },
  ],
  change_request: [
    { number: 'CHG0000001', risk: 'High', state: 'Pending', created: '2026-07-20' },
    { number: 'CHG0000002', risk: 'Low', state: 'Closed', created: '2026-07-15' },
  ],
  sc_req_item: [
    { number: 'RITM0000001', state: 'Open', opened: '2026-07-01' },
  ],
  sc_task: [
    { number: 'SCTASK0000001', state: 'Closed', created: '2026-07-02' },
  ],
};

// Stands in for req.runQuery: answers the number filter tickets.mjs sends,
// with Cube's "cube.column" keys
async function runQuery({ filters }) {
  const [cube] = filters[0].member.split('.');
  const wanted = new Set(filters[0].values);
  return DATA[cube]
    .filter(row => wanted.has(row.number))
    .map(row => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(row).map(([k, v]) => [`${cube}.${k}`, v])));
}
runQuery.scopeKey = 'check';

let failed = 0;
function expect(label, got, want) {
  const ok = JSON.stringify(got) === JSON.stringify(want);
  if (ok) console.log(`PASS: ${label}`);
  else { console.error(`FAIL: ${label}\n  expected ${JSON.stringify(want)}\n  got      ${JSON.stringify(got)}`); failed++; }
}

const numbers = Object.values(DATA).flat().map(r => r.number);
const sorted = await ticketsByPriority(numbers, runQuery);

expect('Assigned to me: P1s (oldest first), High-risk change, P3, P4 and Low risk, then requests and tasks',
  sorted.map(t => t.number),
  ['INC0000003', 'INC0000002', 'CHG0000001', 'INC0000001', 'INC0000004', 'CHG0000002', 'RITM0000001', 'SCTASK0000001']);

expect('Assigned to me: 5 of the 8 are open',
  sorted.filter(t => t.open).length, 5);

expect('a column sorts P2 before P10, and blanks come last',
  sortRows(['P10', '', 'P2', null, 'P1'], v => v),
  ['P1', 'P2', 'P10', '', null]);

expect('blanks still come last sorted the other way',
  sortRows(['P10', '', 'P2', null, 'P1'], v => v, 'desc'),
  ['P10', 'P2', 'P1', '', null]);

if (failed) {
  console.error(`\n${failed} check(s) failed.`);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log('\nAll checks passed.');
```

```yaml
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
      # Fails on any high or critical advisory in what the app runs
      - run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high

  # Rung 2: it is alive. onetouch.fyi is served from Ventura's computer through
  # the Cloudflare tunnel, so this fails whenever that computer or tunnel is off
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: The URL responds and it is ours
        run: |
          URL="https://onetouch.fyi"
          BODY=$(curl -fsS --max-time 20 "$URL")
          echo "$BODY" | grep -q "Sign in to OneTouch" \
            || { echo "::error::The URL responded but the page is not our app."; exit 1; }
          echo "Alive, and it is ours."
```

### B.81 `public/accessibility.js`

```js
// =====================================================================
// ♿ ACCESSIBILITY: settings that make OneTouch easier to see, read, hear
// and use, from the ♿ button in the header (and on the sign-in page):
//   - see: text size, high contrast, easier-to-read text, bold word
//     beginnings (like Bionic Reading), underlined links, a strong focus
//     outline, a big pointer, a reading guide, less motion
//   - 🔍 the magnifier: the text under the pointer (or the focused box), large
//   - 🔊 read aloud: selected text, Claude's answers, or what's pointed at
//   - 🎤 dictation: speak into the Ask bar, the chat, or any text box
// Kept in this browser (so the sign-in page uses them too) and saved to the
// account (prefs.mjs, part "access"), so they follow the person anywhere.
//
// Everything here is inside one function, so its names can't clash with the
// other page scripts (they share one global scope); the page calls only the
// few put on window at the end.
// =====================================================================

(() => {
    const DEFAULTS = {
        textSize: 100, magnify: 2, voice: '', rate: 1, bionicLevel: 2,
        contrast: false, readable: false, bionic: false, underline: false, focus: false, cursor: false, guide: false, motion: false,
        magnifier: false, selectRead: false, speakHover: false, speakAnswers: false, autoSend: false,
    };
    const TEXT_SIZES = [100, 115, 130, 150, 175];
    const MAGNIFY = [2, 3, 4];
    // How much of each word is bold: 1 light, 2 medium, 3 strong
    const BIONIC_LEVELS = [[1, 'Light'], [2, 'Medium'], [3, 'Strong']];
    // On/off settings that are only a class on <html> (style.css)
    const LOOKS = ['contrast', 'readable', 'underline', 'focus', 'cursor', 'motion'];
    const STORE_KEY = 'onetouch-access';

    const synth = window.speechSynthesis || null;
    const Recognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition || null;

    let settings = { ...DEFAULTS, ...readStored() };

    function readStored() {
        try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY) || '{}') || {}; } catch { return {}; }
    }
    function store() {
        try { localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(settings)); } catch { /* this browser forgets them; the account doesn't */ }
    }
    const isDefault = s => Object.keys(DEFAULTS).every(k => s[k] === DEFAULTS[k]);
    const signedIn = () => !document.body.classList.contains('signed-out') && typeof sessionTokenValue !== 'undefined' && sessionTokenValue;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Applying the settings
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    function apply() {
        const root = document.documentElement;
        for (const key of LOOKS) root.classList.toggle(`a11y-${key}`, settings[key]);
        // style.css sizes text in rem, so the root's size scales all of it
        root.style.fontSize = settings.textSize === 100 ? '' : `${settings.textSize}%`;
        guide.hidden = !settings.guide;
        bionicSet(settings.bionic ? settings.bionicLevel : 0);
        if (!settings.magnifier) hideLens();
        if (!settings.selectRead) readBubble.hidden = true;
        document.querySelectorAll('.mic-btn').forEach(b => { b.hidden = !Recognition; });
        paintPanel();
    }

    function change(update, { quiet = false } = {}) {
        settings = { ...settings, ...update };
        store();
        apply();
        if (signedIn() && typeof savePreference === 'function') {
            prefs.access = { ...settings };
            if (quiet) savePreferenceSoon('access'); else savePreference('access');
        }
    }

    // At sign-in (customize.js): the account's settings win. An account with
    // none saved keeps what this browser has, and saves it.
    function accountLoaded(saved) {
        if (saved && typeof saved === 'object') {
            settings = { ...DEFAULTS, ...saved };
            store();
            apply();
        } else if (!isDefault(settings)) {
            change({});
        }
    }

    function signedOut() {
        stopSpeaking();
        stopDictation();
        hideLens();
        readBubble.hidden = true;
        toggleAccessPanel(false);
    }

    function resetAccess() {
        stopSpeaking();
        change({ ...DEFAULTS });
        say('Accessibility settings are back to the default');
    }

    // A message: the page's toast when it's there (signed in), else the panel's status line
    function say(message) {
        if (signedIn() && typeof showToast === 'function') showToast(message);
        else {
            const line = document.getElementById('access-status');
            if (line) line.textContent = message;
        }
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // The ♿ panel
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    function buildPanel() {
        const panel = document.getElementById('access-panel');
        document.getElementById('access-sizes').innerHTML = TEXT_SIZES.map(size =>
            `<label class="choice-pill"><input type="radio" name="a11y-size" value="${size}"><span>${size}%</span></label>`).join('');
        document.getElementById('access-magnify').innerHTML = MAGNIFY.map(n =>
            `<label class="choice-pill"><input type="radio" name="a11y-magnify" value="${n}"><span>${n}×</span></label>`).join('');
        document.getElementById('access-bionic-levels').innerHTML = BIONIC_LEVELS.map(([n, label]) =>
            `<label class="choice-pill"><input type="radio" name="a11y-bionic-level" value="${n}"><span>${label}</span></label>`).join('');
        panel.addEventListener('change', e => {
            const t = e.target;
            if (t.name === 'a11y-size') change({ textSize: Number(t.value) });
            else if (t.name === 'a11y-magnify') change({ magnify: Number(t.value) });
            else if (t.name === 'a11y-bionic-level') change({ bionicLevel: Number(t.value) });
            else if (t.id === 'access-voice') change({ voice: t.value });
            else if (t.dataset.key) change({ [t.dataset.key]: t.checked });
        });
        document.getElementById('access-rate').addEventListener('input', e => change({ rate: Number(e.target.value) }, { quiet: true }));
        document.getElementById('access-try').addEventListener('click', () =>
            speak('This is how OneTouch reads to you. Select any text and press Alt R to hear it.'));
        if (!synth) document.getElementById('access-speech-none').hidden = false;
        if (!Recognition) document.getElementById('access-dictation-none').hidden = false;
        panel.querySelectorAll('[data-needs="speech"]').forEach(el => { el.disabled = !synth; });
        panel.querySelectorAll('[data-needs="dictation"]').forEach(el => { el.disabled = !Recognition; });
        fillVoices();
        synth?.addEventListener?.('voiceschanged', fillVoices);
        paintPanel();
    }

    function fillVoices() {
        const select = document.getElementById('access-voice');
        if (!select || !synth) return;
        const voices = synth.getVoices();
        // The page's language first, then the rest
        const lang = (navigator.language || 'en').slice(0, 2);
        const sorted = [...voices].sort((a, b) => (b.lang.startsWith(lang) - a.lang.startsWith(lang)) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
        select.innerHTML = '<option value="">The browser\'s usual voice</option>' + sorted.map(v =>
            `<option value="${escapeAttr(v.name)}">${escapeAttr(v.name)} (${escapeAttr(v.lang)})</option>`).join('');
        select.value = voices.some(v => v.name === settings.voice) ? settings.voice : '';
    }

    function paintPanel() {
        const panel = document.getElementById('access-panel');
        if (!panel) return;
        panel.querySelectorAll('input[name="a11y-size"]').forEach(r => { r.checked = Number(r.value) === settings.textSize; });
        panel.querySelectorAll('input[name="a11y-magnify"]').forEach(r => { r.checked = Number(r.value) === settings.magnify; });
        panel.querySelectorAll('input[name="a11y-bionic-level"]').forEach(r => { r.checked = Number(r.value) === settings.bionicLevel; });
        panel.querySelectorAll('input[data-key]').forEach(c => { c.checked = settings[c.dataset.key] === true; });
        const rate = document.getElementById('access-rate');
        rate.value = settings.rate;
        document.getElementById('access-rate-value').textContent = `${settings.rate.toFixed(1)}×`;
        const voice = document.getElementById('access-voice');
        if (voice && [...voice.options].some(o => o.value === settings.voice)) voice.value = settings.voice;
    }

    function toggleAccessPanel(open) {
        const panel = document.getElementById('access-panel');
        if (!panel) return;
        const willOpen = typeof open === 'boolean' ? open : panel.hidden;
        panel.hidden = !willOpen;
        document.querySelectorAll('.access-btn').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(willOpen)));
        if (willOpen) {
            document.getElementById('access-status').textContent = '';
            panel.querySelector('input:checked, input')?.focus();
        } else if (panel.contains(document.activeElement)) {
            // The header's ♿ signed in, the sign-in page's otherwise (the other isn't shown)
            [...document.querySelectorAll('.access-btn')].find(b => b.getClientRects().length > 0)?.focus();
        }
    }

    // A click outside the panel closes it
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
        const panel = document.getElementById('access-panel');
        if (panel && !panel.hidden && !panel.contains(e.target) && !e.target.closest('.access-btn')) toggleAccessPanel(false);
    });

    const escapeAttr = s => String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // What a place on the page says: the text under the pointer, a box's
    // label and value (never a password), a picture's description
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    const MAX_TEXT = 400;

    function fieldText(el) {
        const label = el.labels?.[0]?.innerText.trim() || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.placeholder || el.title || '';
        if (el.type === 'password') return label ? `${label} (password box)` : 'Password box';
        if (el.tagName === 'SELECT') return [label, el.selectedOptions[0]?.text].filter(Boolean).join(': ');
        if (['checkbox', 'radio'].includes(el.type)) {
            const name = el.closest('label')?.innerText.trim() || label;
            return `${name}: ${el.checked ? 'on' : 'off'}`;
        }
        if (['button', 'submit'].includes(el.type)) return el.value || label;
        const value = el.value.trim();
        return value ? (label && label !== value ? `${label}: ${value}` : value) : label;
    }

    function elementText(el) {
        if (!el || el.closest('.a11y-lens, iframe')) return null;
        if (el.matches('input, textarea, select')) return fieldText(el);
        if (el.matches('img')) return el.alt || null;
        const named = el.closest('[aria-label], [title]');
        const own = el.innerText?.trim();
        if (own && own.length <= MAX_TEXT) return own;
        return named?.getAttribute('aria-label') || named?.title || null;
    }

    // -> { text, el } for the point (x, y), or null
    function textAt(x, y) {
        const el = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
        if (!el || el.closest('.a11y-ui, iframe')) return null;
        if (el.matches('input, textarea, select, img')) return { text: elementText(el), el };
        const node = caretNode(x, y);
        if (node?.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.textContent.trim() && el.contains(node) && pointOnText(node, x, y)) {
            const host = node.parentElement;
            // The whole label, cell, line or button the words belong to, when it's short
            const block = host.closest('button, a, label, th, td, li, p, h1, h2, h3, h4, legend, summary, option, .msg, div, section') || host;
            // textContent first: it's cheap, and innerText of a big table on every move isn't
            const blockText = block.textContent.length <= MAX_TEXT * 2 ? block.innerText?.trim() : '';
            const text = blockText && blockText.length <= MAX_TEXT ? blockText : node.textContent.trim().slice(0, MAX_TEXT);
            return { text, el: block };
        }
        // A button with only an icon still has a name
        const named = el.closest('button, a, [role="button"], [aria-label]');
        const name = named && (named.getAttribute('aria-label') || named.title || named.innerText?.trim());
        return name ? { text: name.slice(0, MAX_TEXT), el: named } : null;
    }

    function caretNode(x, y) {
        if (document.caretPositionFromPoint) return document.caretPositionFromPoint(x, y)?.offsetNode || null;
        if (document.caretRangeFromPoint) return document.caretRangeFromPoint(x, y)?.startContainer || null;
        return null;
    }

    // The caret functions find the nearest text; only text actually under the pointer counts
    function pointOnText(node, x, y) {
        const range = document.createRange();
        range.selectNodeContents(node);
        return [...range.getClientRects()].some(r => x >= r.left - 2 && x <= r.right + 2 && y >= r.top - 2 && y <= r.bottom + 2);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // 🔍 The magnifier: a box beside the pointer with that text, large.
    // With the keyboard, the focused box or button's text.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    const lens = document.createElement('div');
    lens.className = 'a11y-lens a11y-ui';
    lens.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); // screen readers already read the page itself
    lens.hidden = true;

    function showLens(text, x, y) {
        if (!text) return hideLens();
        lens.textContent = text;
        lens.style.fontSize = `${settings.magnify}rem`;
        lens.hidden = false;
        const gap = 18;
        const { width, height } = lens.getBoundingClientRect();
        let left = x + gap;
        let top = y + gap + 6;
        if (left + width > innerWidth - 8) left = Math.max(8, x - gap - width);
        if (top + height > innerHeight - 8) top = Math.max(8, y - gap - height);
        lens.style.left = `${left}px`;
        lens.style.top = `${top}px`;
    }
    function hideLens() { lens.hidden = true; }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Bold word beginnings (like Bionic Reading): the first part of each
    // word in bold, so the eye moves from word to word. Each text node is
    // wrapped where it is (<span class="a11y-bionic"> with <b>s inside), so
    // the page's text (textContent) stays the same for the code that reads
    // it, copying and read-aloud. Text that arrives later is wrapped as it
    // comes, a little at a time; switching off puts the plain text back.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    // The share of each word in bold, per level
    const BIONIC_SHARE = { 1: 0.3, 2: 0.45, 3: 0.6 };
    // Not inside these: boxes and menus can't hold bold, charts are drawn as
    // pictures (svg), and the rest isn't text for reading
    const BIONIC_SKIP = 'script, style, noscript, textarea, input, select, option, svg, iframe, canvas, code, pre, kbd, ' +
        '.a11y-ui, .a11y-bionic, .picture-host, [contenteditable="true"]';
    // A word: letters only, so ticket numbers (INC1234567) and codes (P1) stay as they are
    const BIONIC_WORD = /(?<![\p{L}\p{N}])\p{L}[\p{L}\p{M}'’]*(?![\p{L}\p{N}])/gu;
    let bionicLevel = 0; // what the page is wrapped at now; 0 when off
    let bionicQueue = [];
    let bionicNext = 0;
    let bionicTimer = null;
    let bionicObserver = null;

    function bionicFragment(text, share) {
        const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
        let at = 0;
        for (const m of text.matchAll(BIONIC_WORD)) {
            const word = m[0];
            if (word.length < 2) continue;
            const bold = Math.max(1, Math.round(word.length * share));
            if (m.index > at) frag.append(text.slice(at, m.index));
            const b = document.createElement('b');
            b.textContent = word.slice(0, bold);
            frag.append(b, word.slice(bold));
            at = m.index + word.length;
        }
        if (!at) return null;
        if (at < text.length) frag.append(text.slice(at));
        return frag;
    }

    function bionicWrap(node, share) {
        const parent = node.parentElement;
        if (!node.isConnected || !parent || parent.closest(BIONIC_SKIP)) return;
        const frag = bionicFragment(node.data, share);
        if (!frag) return;
        const span = document.createElement('span');
        span.className = 'a11y-bionic';
        span.append(frag);
        node.replaceWith(span);
    }

    // Every text node in root, leaving out whole BIONIC_SKIP parts
    function bionicCollect(root) {
        if (root.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
            if (/\p{L}{2}/u.test(root.data)) bionicQueue.push(root);
            return;
        }
        if (root.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE || root.closest(BIONIC_SKIP)) return;
        const walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT | NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
            acceptNode: n => n.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE
                ? (n.matches(BIONIC_SKIP) ? NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT : NodeFilter.FILTER_SKIP)
                : (/\p{L}{2}/u.test(n.data) ? NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT : NodeFilter.FILTER_SKIP),
        });
        for (let n = walker.nextNode(); n; n = walker.nextNode()) bionicQueue.push(n);
    }

    // A few milliseconds at a time, so a long table never freezes the page
    function bionicRun() {
        bionicTimer = null;
        const share = BIONIC_SHARE[bionicLevel];
        if (!share) { bionicQueue = []; bionicNext = 0; return; }
        const until = performance.now() + 8;
        while (bionicNext < bionicQueue.length && performance.now() < until) bionicWrap(bionicQueue[bionicNext++], share);
        if (bionicNext < bionicQueue.length) bionicTimer = setTimeout(bionicRun, 0);
        else { bionicQueue = []; bionicNext = 0; }
    }
    const bionicSchedule = () => { if (!bionicTimer && bionicQueue.length) bionicTimer = setTimeout(bionicRun, 0); };

    function bionicSet(level) {
        if (level === bionicLevel) return;
        // Putting the plain text back mustn't be seen as new text to wrap
        bionicObserver?.disconnect();
        clearTimeout(bionicTimer);
        bionicTimer = null;
        bionicQueue = [];
        bionicNext = 0;
        document.querySelectorAll('span.a11y-bionic').forEach(span => span.replaceWith(span.textContent));
        bionicLevel = level;
        if (!level) return;
        bionicCollect(document.body);
        bionicSchedule();
        bionicObserver ||= new MutationObserver(changes => {
            for (const c of changes) {
                if (c.type === 'characterData') bionicCollect(c.target);
                else c.addedNodes.forEach(n => { if (!n.classList?.contains('a11y-bionic')) bionicCollect(n); });
            }
            bionicSchedule();
        });
        bionicObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // The reading guide: a band across the page that follows the pointer
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    const guide = document.createElement('div');
    guide.className = 'a11y-guide a11y-ui';
    guide.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    guide.hidden = true;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Following the pointer: the magnifier, the guide and reading what's
    // pointed at all look at the same spot, once per frame
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    let pointer = null;
    let framePending = false;
    let hover = { text: null, since: 0, spoken: null };
    const HOVER_READ_MS = 700;

    document.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
        if (e.pointerType === 'touch') return;
        pointer = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
        if (!framePending) { framePending = true; requestAnimationFrame(followPointer); }
    }, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { hideLens(); pointer = null; });
    document.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (settings.magnifier && pointer) requestAnimationFrame(followPointer); }, { passive: true, capture: true });

    function followPointer() {
        framePending = false;
        if (!pointer) return;
        if (settings.guide) guide.style.top = `${pointer.y}px`;
        if (!settings.magnifier && !settings.speakHover) return;
        const found = textAt(pointer.x, pointer.y);
        if (settings.magnifier) {
            if (found?.text) showLens(found.text, pointer.x, pointer.y);
            else hideLens();
        }
        if (settings.speakHover) {
            const text = found?.text || null;
            if (text !== hover.text) hover = { text, since: Date.now(), spoken: hover.spoken };
            clearTimeout(hoverTimer);
            if (text && text !== hover.spoken) hoverTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                if (hover.text === text) { hover.spoken = text; speak(text); }
            }, HOVER_READ_MS);
        }
    }
    let hoverTimer = null;

    // The magnifier for keyboard users: the focused element's text, by it
    document.addEventListener('focusin', e => {
        if (!settings.magnifier || e.target.closest?.('.a11y-ui') || !e.target.getBoundingClientRect) return;
        const text = elementText(e.target);
        const r = e.target.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (text) showLens(text, r.left, r.bottom);
    });

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // 🔊 Reading aloud (the browser's own voices, speechSynthesis)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    // Ticket numbers read as what they are, digit by digit, not as millions
    const TICKET_WORDS = { INC: 'incident', CHG: 'change', RITM: 'request item', SCTASK: 'catalog task', REQ: 'request', PRB: 'problem' };
    function speakable(text) {
        return String(text)
            .replace(/\b(INC|CHG|RITM|SCTASK|REQ|PRB)(\d{7})\b/gi, (m, p, d) => `${TICKET_WORDS[p.toUpperCase()]} ${d.split('').join(' ')}`)
            .replace(/[\u{1F300}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{27BF}\u{FE0F}]/gu, ' ') // emoji are read out by name otherwise
            .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
            .trim();
    }

    // Long text in sentence-sized pieces: some browsers stop a single long one partway
    function pieces(text, size = 220) {
        const out = [];
        let rest = text;
        while (rest.length > size) {
            const cut = Math.max(rest.lastIndexOf('. ', size), rest.lastIndexOf(', ', size), rest.lastIndexOf(' ', size));
            const at = cut > 40 ? cut + 1 : size;
            out.push(rest.slice(0, at));
            rest = rest.slice(at).trim();
        }
        if (rest) out.push(rest);
        return out;
    }

    let speakingId = 0;
    function speak(text) {
        if (!synth) { say('This browser can\'t read aloud. Edge, Chrome and Safari can.'); return; }
        const words = speakable(text);
        if (!words) return;
        stopSpeaking();
        const id = ++speakingId;
        const voice = synth.getVoices().find(v => v.name === settings.voice);
        const parts = pieces(words);
        // Starting straight after cancel() is sometimes dropped, so give it a moment
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (id !== speakingId) return;
            parts.forEach((part, i) => {
                const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(part);
                if (voice) u.voice = voice;
                u.lang = voice?.lang || navigator.language || 'en-US';
                u.rate = settings.rate;
                if (i === parts.length - 1) u.onend = u.onerror = () => { if (id === speakingId) speakingPill.hidden = true; };
                synth.speak(u);
            });
            speakingPill.hidden = false;
        }, 60);
    }

    function stopSpeaking() {
        speakingId++;
        if (synth && (synth.speaking || synth.pending)) synth.cancel();
        speakingPill.hidden = true;
    }

    // "🔊 Reading… ⏹ Stop", while it reads
    const speakingPill = document.createElement('div');
    speakingPill.className = 'a11y-pill a11y-ui';
    speakingPill.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    speakingPill.hidden = true;
    speakingPill.innerHTML = '<span>🔊 Reading aloud…</span><button type="button" class="a11y-pill-btn">⏹ Stop</button>';
    speakingPill.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', stopSpeaking);

    // An answer in the chat, as it's best heard: its words, and each table
    // as how many rows and which columns (a whole table read cell by cell is
    // too long to follow; selecting cells reads them)
    function answerSpeech(msg) {
        const copy = msg.cloneNode(true);
        copy.querySelectorAll('.msg-read-btn, .download-bar, [hidden], script, style').forEach(n => n.remove());
        copy.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(table => {
            const rows = table.tBodies[0]?.rows.length ?? Math.max(0, table.rows.length - 1);
            const columns = [...table.querySelectorAll('thead th')].map(th => th.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean);
            table.replaceWith(document.createTextNode(
                ` A table with ${rows.toLocaleString()} ${rows === 1 ? 'row' : 'rows'}${columns.length ? `. Its columns are ${columns.join(', ')}` : ''}. `));
        });
        // Blocks end in a pause, so words from two lines don't run together
        copy.querySelectorAll('div, p, li, summary, h1, h2, h3, h4').forEach(n => n.append('. '));
        return copy.textContent.replace(/(\.\s*){2,}/g, '. ');
    }

    // 🔊 Read on each of Claude's answers
    function addReadButtons(root) {
        if (!synth) return;
        const messages = root.matches?.('.msg.ai-msg') ? [root] : [...(root.querySelectorAll?.('.msg.ai-msg') || [])];
        for (const msg of messages) {
            if (msg.classList.contains('query-progress') || msg.querySelector(':scope > .msg-read-btn')) continue;
            const button = document.createElement('button');
            button.type = 'button';
            button.className = 'msg-read-btn a11y-ui';
            button.textContent = '🔊 Read';
            button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Read this answer aloud');
            button.addEventListener('click', () => speak(answerSpeech(msg)));
            msg.prepend(button);
        }
    }

    // A new answer read by itself, when asked for
    document.addEventListener('onetouch:answer', () => {
        if (!settings.speakAnswers) return;
        const last = [...document.querySelectorAll('#chat-log .msg.ai-msg:not(.query-progress)')].pop();
        if (last) speak(answerSpeech(last));
    });

    // Selected text gets a "🔊 Read" button by it
    const readBubble = document.createElement('button');
    readBubble.type = 'button';
    readBubble.className = 'a11y-read-bubble a11y-ui';
    readBubble.textContent = '🔊 Read';
    readBubble.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Read the selected text aloud');
    readBubble.hidden = true;
    readBubble.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => e.preventDefault()); // keeps the selection
    readBubble.addEventListener('click', () => { speak(selectedText()); readBubble.hidden = true; });

    function selectedText() {
        const field = document.activeElement;
        if (field?.matches?.('textarea, input:not([type="password"])') && field.selectionStart !== field.selectionEnd) {
            return field.value.slice(field.selectionStart, field.selectionEnd);
        }
        return String(window.getSelection() || '');
    }

    let bubbleTimer = null;
    document.addEventListener('selectionchange', () => {
        clearTimeout(bubbleTimer);
        bubbleTimer = setTimeout(placeBubble, 250);
    });
    function placeBubble() {
        const sel = window.getSelection();
        if (!settings.selectRead || !synth || !sel || sel.isCollapsed || sel.toString().trim().length < 2) { readBubble.hidden = true; return; }
        const rects = sel.getRangeAt(0).getClientRects();
        const last = rects[rects.length - 1];
        if (!last) { readBubble.hidden = true; return; }
        readBubble.hidden = false;
        const { width } = readBubble.getBoundingClientRect();
        readBubble.style.left = `${Math.min(innerWidth - width - 8, Math.max(8, last.right - width / 2))}px`;
        readBubble.style.top = `${Math.min(innerHeight - 40, last.bottom + 8)}px`;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // 🎤 Dictation (the browser's speech recognition): into the Ask bar,
    // the chat's box, or whichever text box has the cursor
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    // Boxes that ask Claude when dictation ends, with "Ask as soon as I stop talking"
    const SENDERS = {
        'nav-ask-input': () => typeof askFromHeader === 'function' && askFromHeader(),
        'user-prompt': () => typeof sendPrompt === 'function' && sendPrompt(),
    };
    const isTextBox = el => el?.matches?.('textarea, input:not([type]), input[type="text"], input[type="search"], input[type="email"]') && !el.disabled && !el.readOnly;

    let dictation = null; // { rec, field, button }

    function startDictation(target, button = null) {
        if (!Recognition) { say('This browser can\'t take dictation. Use Edge or Chrome.'); return; }
        if (dictation) { stopDictation(); return; }
        let field = typeof target === 'string' ? document.getElementById(target) : target;
        if (!isTextBox(field)) field = isTextBox(document.activeElement) ? document.activeElement : document.getElementById(signedIn() ? 'nav-ask-input' : 'login-email');
        if (!isTextBox(field)) { say('Click in a text box first, then press Alt M.'); return; }
        stopSpeaking();
        field.focus();

        const start = field.selectionStart ?? field.value.length;
        const end = field.selectionEnd ?? field.value.length;
        const before = field.value.slice(0, start);
        const after = field.value.slice(end);
        const joiner = before && !/\s$/.test(before) ? ' ' : '';
        const max = field.maxLength > 0 ? field.maxLength : Infinity;
        const send = settings.autoSend ? SENDERS[field.id] : null;

        const rec = new Recognition();
        rec.lang = navigator.language || 'en-US';
        rec.interimResults = true;
        // Asking when they stop: one phrase. Otherwise it listens until stopped.
        rec.continuous = !send;
        let heard = '';
        rec.onresult = e => {
            let text = '';
            for (const result of e.results) text += result[0].transcript;
            heard = text.trim();
            field.value = (before + joiner + heard + after).slice(0, max);
            const caret = Math.min(max, (before + joiner + heard).length);
            field.setSelectionRange?.(caret, caret);
            field.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        };
        rec.onerror = e => {
            const why = {
                'not-allowed': 'The microphone isn\'t allowed. Allow it for this site (the 🔒 or 🎤 by the address), then try again.',
                'service-not-allowed': 'The microphone isn\'t allowed. Allow it for this site (the 🔒 or 🎤 by the address), then try again.',
                'no-speech': 'Nothing was heard. Press 🎤 and speak.',
                'audio-capture': 'No microphone was found.',
                'network': 'Dictation needs the internet: the browser turns speech into text online.',
            }[e.error];
            if (why) say(why);
        };
        rec.onend = () => {
            const wasThis = dictation?.rec === rec;
            if (wasThis) endDictationUi();
            if (wasThis && send && heard) send();
        };
        dictation = { rec, field, button: button || document.querySelector(`.mic-btn[data-mic-for="${field.id}"]`) };
        dictation.button?.classList.add('listening');
        dictation.button?.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
        listeningPill.hidden = false;
        try { rec.start(); } catch { endDictationUi(); }
    }

    function stopDictation() {
        if (!dictation) return;
        try { dictation.rec.stop(); } catch { /* already stopped */ }
        endDictationUi();
    }

    function endDictationUi() {
        dictation?.button?.classList.remove('listening');
        dictation?.button?.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
        dictation = null;
        listeningPill.hidden = true;
    }

    const listeningPill = document.createElement('div');
    listeningPill.className = 'a11y-pill a11y-pill-listening a11y-ui';
    listeningPill.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    listeningPill.hidden = true;
    listeningPill.innerHTML = '<span>🎤 Listening… speak now</span><button type="button" class="a11y-pill-btn">⏹ Stop</button>';
    listeningPill.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', stopDictation);

    // 🎤 buttons: <button class="mic-btn" data-mic-for="the box's id">
    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
        const mic = e.target.closest?.('.mic-btn');
        if (!mic) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        startDictation(mic.dataset.micFor, mic);
    });
    // Pressing 🎤 mustn't take the cursor out of the box being dictated into
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { if (e.target.closest?.('.mic-btn')) e.preventDefault(); });

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Keyboard: Alt+A the panel, Alt+R read, Alt+M dictate, Esc stops
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            if (dictation) stopDictation();
            if (synth?.speaking) stopSpeaking();
            hideLens();
            const panel = document.getElementById('access-panel');
            if (panel && !panel.hidden) toggleAccessPanel(false);
            return;
        }
        if (!e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
        if (e.code === 'KeyA') { e.preventDefault(); toggleAccessPanel(); }
        else if (e.code === 'KeyR') {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (synth?.speaking) return stopSpeaking();
            const text = selectedText().trim()
                || (pointer && textAt(pointer.x, pointer.y)?.text)
                || elementText(document.activeElement);
            if (text) speak(text); else say('Select some text (or point at it), then press Alt R.');
        } else if (e.code === 'KeyM') { e.preventDefault(); startDictation(document.activeElement); }
    });

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Start
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    function start() {
        document.body.append(lens, guide, speakingPill, listeningPill, readBubble);
        buildPanel();
        apply();
        const log = document.getElementById('chat-log');
        if (log) {
            addReadButtons(log);
            new MutationObserver(changes => changes.forEach(c => c.addedNodes.forEach(n => n.nodeType === 1 && addReadButtons(n))))
                .observe(log, { childList: true });
        }
    }
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
    else start();

    Object.assign(window, {
        toggleAccessPanel, resetAccess,
        a11yAccountLoaded: accountLoaded, a11ySignedOut: signedOut,
    });
})();
```

```js
const OVERVIEW = 'A person asks a question on the page. The Node server checks who they are and what they may see, Claude turns the question into a query, and Cube runs it against the ticket data in Postgres. Metabase draws the dashboards from the same data. Every container runs under Docker Compose on one computer, and Cloudflare Tunnel is the only way in from the internet.';

// The floor frame in the scene: what Docker Compose runs, and what it doesn't
const COMPOSE = {
  name: 'Docker Compose: one computer',
  note: 'Every container publishes its port on 127.0.0.1 only. The ServiceNow listener and the outside services are outside this frame.',
  min: [-10, -1.2, -7],
  max: [10, 20, 7],
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// Versions: read from the files that decide them, so they can't fall behind
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------

function readIfThere(file) {
  try {
    return readFileSync(new URL(file, import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// image -> tag, from docker-compose.yml
export function composeImages(text = readIfThere('./docker-compose.yml')) {
  const images = {};
  for (const m of String(text || '').matchAll(/^\s*image:\s*([^\s:#]+):([^\s#]+)/gm)) images[m[1]] = m[2];
  return images;
}

function lockVersions(file) {
  try {
    const { packages } = JSON.parse(readIfThere(file));
    return name => packages[`node_modules/${name}`]?.version || null;
  } catch {
    return () => null;
  }
}

function threeVersion() {
  const m = readIfThere('./public/architecture.js')?.match(/vendor\/three-([\d.]+)\//);
  return m ? m[1] : null;
}

function buildStack(model, open) {
  const images = composeImages();
  const npm = lockVersions('./package-lock.json');
  const three = threeVersion();
  return [
    { group: 'Containers (docker-compose.yml)', items: [
      { name: 'PostgreSQL', version: images.postgres, role: 'Tickets and accounts, in two databases' },
      { name: 'Cube', version: images['cubejs/cube'], role: 'Semantic layer' },
      { name: 'Metabase', version: images['metabase/metabase'], role: 'Dashboards' },
      { name: 'cloudflared', version: images['cloudflare/cloudflared'], role: 'The tunnel from the internet' },
    ] },
    { group: 'Server (package-lock.json)', items: [
      { name: 'Node.js', version: process.version.replace(/^v/, ''), role: 'What this server is running on' },
      { name: 'Express', version: npm('express'), role: 'Web server' },
      { name: 'pg', version: npm('pg'), role: 'Postgres client' },
      { name: 'Anthropic SDK', version: npm('@anthropic-ai/sdk'), role: 'Calls Claude' },
      { name: 'pdfmake', version: npm('pdfmake'), role: 'PDF downloads' },
      { name: 'docx', version: npm('docx'), role: 'Word downloads' },
      { name: 'ExcelJS', version: npm('exceljs'), role: 'Excel downloads' },
    ] },
    { group: 'The page (public/)', items: [
      { name: 'JavaScript and CSS', version: 'no build step', role: 'No framework or bundler' },
      { name: 'three.js', version: three, role: 'This 3D map only, loaded when an admin opens it' },
    ] },
    { group: 'Outside services', items: [
      { name: 'Claude', version: model || null, role: 'Turns questions into queries' },
      { name: 'Brevo', version: 'API v3', role: 'Notification emails' },
      { name: 'Cloudflare', version: 'Tunnel', role: 'The public https address' },
      { name: 'GitHub Actions', version: 'CI', role: 'Checks on every push' },
    ] },
    { group: 'ServiceNow live push (servicenow-sync/)', items: [
      { name: 'Listener', version: 'built', role: 'Express on port 8090, its own process' },
      { name: 'ServiceNow side', version: open ? 'records arriving' : 'needs authentication', role: 'REST Message, Script Include, Business Rules' },
    ] },
  ];
}

function nodeVersion(node, images, npm, pushNpm) {
  if (node.image) return images[node.image] || null;
  if (node.runtime) return `${npm(node.npm)}, Node ${process.version.replace(/^v/, '')}`;
  if (node.npm) return npm(node.npm);
  if (node.pushNpm) return pushNpm(node.pushNpm);
  return null;
}

// What the signals say about the push. It can only ever say what this server
// has heard, so "needs authentication" stays until a record really arrives.
export function pushState(push = {}) {
  return {
    state: push.heard > 0 ? 'receiving' : 'needs-auth',
    listening: Boolean(push.listening),
    heard: push.heard || 0,
    lastAt: push.lastAt || null,
    last: push.last || null,
    since: push.since || null,
  };
}

// Everything the page draws. model: the Claude model in use; push: what this
// server has heard from the listener (server.mjs)
export function architectureMap({ model = null, push = {} } = {}) {
  const images = composeImages();
  const npm = lockVersions('./package-lock.json');
  const pushNpm = lockVersions('./servicenow-sync/package-lock.json');
  const status = pushState(push);
  const open = status.state === 'receiving';
  // A step's own words for after the gate is open; the page never gets a phase then
  const flows = !open ? FLOWS : FLOWS.map(flow => (!flow.pending ? flow : {
    ...flow,
    steps: flow.steps.map(({ phase, stop, open: after, ...step }) => ({ ...step, ...after })),
  }));
  const { openSummary, ...servicenow } = SERVICENOW;
  return {
    overview: OVERVIEW,
    compose: COMPOSE,
    layers: LAYERS,
    nodes: NODES.map(({ image, npm: pkg, runtime, pushNpm: pushPkg, ...node }) => ({
      ...node,
      version: nodeVersion({ image, npm: pkg, runtime, pushNpm: pushPkg }, images, npm, pushNpm),
      facts: node.id === 'claude' ? [...node.facts, ['Model in use', model || 'not known']] : node.facts,
    })),
    links: LINKS,
    flows,
    stack: buildStack(model, open),
    servicenow: open ? { ...servicenow, summary: openSummary } : servicenow,
    push: status,
  };
}
```

```js
// 🧊 ARCHITECTURE (admins only): a 3D map of how OneTouch is built, and the
// ServiceNow live push, which is built but needs ServiceNow's authentication.
//
// This file can be read without signing in, so it only holds the drawing
// code. Everything the map says comes from GET /api/architecture, which only
// answers admins (architecture.mjs). three.js is loaded the first time an
// admin opens the map, so nobody else's page pays for it.
//
// The same content is in a list (📝 List), for screen readers and for
// browsers that can't draw 3D. One function, so its names can't clash with
// the other page scripts.
// =====================================================================

(function () {
    'use strict';

    const THREE_URL = './vendor/three-0.186.1/three.module.js';
    const POLL_MS = 20 * 1000;

    let world = null;      // the 3D scene; null when only the list can be shown
    let active = false;
    let loading = null;    // the first opening, while it's still under way
    let opening = 0;       // goes up at sign-out, so a late answer can't draw the map for the next person
    let mode = '3d';       // '3d' or 'list'
    let sideTab = 'details';
    let selected = null;   // a block's id
    let focusLayer = null; // a layer's id
    let pollTimer = null;
    let health = null;     // the last health report (GET /api/architecture/health)
    let healthError = null;// why there isn't a fresh one
    let healthErrorSince = null;
    let issues = null;     // what people have reported: { openCount, open, resolved }
    let sideShown = null;  // the tab the side panel last drew, so a redraw keeps its place
    const RAIL_KEY = 'onetouch-arch-rail-min';
    let railMin = false;   // the left side bar minimized
    try { railMin = localStorage.getItem(RAIL_KEY) === '1'; } catch { /* Open, then */ }
    const player = { flow: null, index: 0, playing: false, elapsed: 0, hold: 0 };

    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
    const esc = value => escapeHtml(String(value ?? ''));
    const nodeById = id => map.nodes.find(n => n.id === id);
    const layerById = id => map.layers.find(l => l.id === id);
    const lessMotion = () => document.documentElement.classList.contains('a11y-motion')
        || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    const receiving = () => map?.push.state === 'receiving';
    const colorVar = name => `var(--${/^(series-[1-8]|warn)$/.test(name) ? name : 'muted'})`;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // The page's text (everything but the scene)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    function pageHtml() {
        // The status and the rail first: keys and screen readers reach them before the blocks' names
        return `
            <div class="arch-status" id="arch-status" role="status"></div>
            <nav class="arch-rail" id="arch-rail" aria-label="Architecture map"></nav>
            <div class="arch-stage" id="arch-stage" tabindex="0" role="group"
                 aria-label="3D map of OneTouch. Arrow keys turn it, plus and minus zoom, 0 resets the view. Each block is a button. The List view has the same information.">
                <canvas id="arch-canvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
                <div class="arch-tags" id="arch-tags"></div>
                <p class="arch-hint">Drag to turn · scroll to zoom · Shift+drag to move · click a block. Moving dots show which way data goes, not live traffic.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="arch-list" id="arch-list" hidden></div>
            <section class="arch-step" id="arch-step" aria-live="polite" hidden></section>
            <aside class="arch-side" id="arch-side" aria-label="Details"></aside>`;
    }

    // What isn't working right now: the health report, or the server not answering at all
    function problems() {
        if (healthError) return [{ id: 'server', name: 'OneTouch server', text: healthError, effect: 'What this page shows may be out of date.', since: healthErrorSince }];
        return (health?.checks || []).filter(c => c.state === 'problem');
    }

    function statusHtml() {
        const list = problems();
        const shown = list.slice(0, 3);
        const bad = !list.length ? '' : `<div class="arch-status-row arch-status-problems">
                <span class="arch-chip arch-chip-stop">⚠️ ${list.length} problem${list.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
                <span class="arch-status-text">${shown.map(p => `<b>${esc(p.name)}:</b> ${esc(p.text)}`).join('<br>')}${list.length > shown.length ? `<br>and ${list.length - shown.length} more` : ''}</span>
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-side="health">See what's wrong</button>
            </div>`;
        const open = issues?.openCount || 0;
        const latest = issues?.open[0];
        const reported = !open ? '' : `<div class="arch-status-row arch-status-problems">
                <span class="arch-chip arch-chip-warn">📣 ${open} open report${open === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
                <span class="arch-status-text">${latest ? `<b>Latest, from ${esc(latest.reporter)}:</b> ${esc(latest.label)}` : ''}</span>
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-side="reports">See the reports</button>
            </div>`;
        return `${bad}${reported}<div class="arch-status-row">${pushStatusHtml()}</div>`;
    }

    // One report. Someone's own words, so escaped like everything else here.
    function reportHtml(r, resolved) {
        const where = r.page ? ` · on ${esc(r.page)}` : '';
        const done = resolved ? `<br><span class="arch-small">Resolved ${esc(when(r.resolvedAt))}${r.resolver ? ` by ${esc(r.resolver)}` : ''}.</span>` : '';
        return `<li class="arch-report">
                <span class="arch-report-kind">${esc(r.label)}</span>
                <p class="arch-report-message">${esc(r.message)}</p>
                <span class="arch-small"><b>${esc(r.reporter)}</b> · ${esc(when(r.at))}${where}</span>${done}
                ${r.browser ? `<br><span class="arch-small">${esc(r.browser)}</span>` : ''}
                <div class="arch-report-foot">
                    <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-issue="${esc(r.id)}" data-issue-status="${resolved ? 'open' : 'resolved'}">${resolved ? '↩ Reopen' : '✓ Mark resolved'}</button>
                </div>
            </li>`;
    }

    // What people have told the admins (the 🚩 in the header)
    function reportsHtml(Heading = 'h3') {
        const title = `<${Heading} class="arch-node-name">📣 Problems people reported</${Heading}>`;
        if (!issues) return `${title}<p>Loading the reports…</p>`;
        const open = issues.open.length
            ? `<ul class="arch-checks">${issues.open.map(r => reportHtml(r, false)).join('')}</ul>`
            : '<p class="arch-notice arch-notice-good"><b>✅ No open reports.</b></p>';
        const resolved = issues.resolved.length
            ? `<details class="arch-reports-done"><summary>Resolved lately (${issues.resolved.length})</summary>
                <ul class="arch-checks">${issues.resolved.map(r => reportHtml(r, true)).join('')}</ul></details>` : '';
        return `${title}${open}${resolved}
            <p class="arch-small">Anyone signed in can send one with the 🚩 in the header. Admins are told under the 🔔 and by email.</p>`;
    }

    // Every check: what's wrong first, then what's working
    function healthHtml(Heading = 'h3') {
        const rank = { problem: 0, off: 1, ok: 2 };
        const checks = [...(health?.checks || [])].sort((a, b) => rank[a.state] - rank[b.state]);
        const list = problems();
        const icon = { problem: '⚠️', off: '⚪', ok: '✅' };
        const summary = list.length
            ? `<p class="arch-notice arch-notice-bad"><b>⚠️ ${list.length} problem${list.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} right now.</b></p>`
            : health ? '<p class="arch-notice arch-notice-good"><b>✅ Everything checked is working.</b></p>' : '<p>Checking…</p>';
        const server = healthError ? `<li class="arch-check arch-check-problem"><b>⚠️ OneTouch server</b><br>${esc(healthError)}<br><span class="arch-small">Noticed ${esc(when(healthErrorSince))}. These results are from the last answer.</span></li>` : '';
        return `
            <${Heading} class="arch-node-name">🩺 Is everything working?</${Heading}>
            ${summary}
            <ul class="arch-checks">${server}${checks.map(c => `
                <li class="arch-check arch-check-${esc(c.state)}">
                    <b>${icon[c.state] || ''} ${c.node ? `<button type="button" class="arch-link" data-node="${esc(c.node)}">${esc(c.name)}</button>` : esc(c.name)}</b><br>
                    ${esc(c.text)}
                    ${c.effect ? `<br><b>What this means:</b> ${esc(c.effect)}` : ''}
                    ${c.state === 'problem' && c.detail && c.detail !== c.text ? `<br><span class="arch-small">${esc(c.detail)}</span>` : ''}
                    <br><span class="arch-small">${c.since ? `Since ${esc(when(c.since))}. ` : ''}Checked ${esc(when(c.checkedAt))}.</span>
                </li>`).join('')}</ul>
            <p class="arch-small">Each check really tries the thing, while this page is open, every 30 seconds or so. Outside services are asked less often. ServiceNow's authentication is listed in the banner, and in its own tab.</p>`;
    }

    function pushStatusHtml() {
        const push = map.push;
        const s = map.servicenow;
        if (receiving()) {
            return `<span class="arch-chip arch-chip-good">🔓 Records arriving</span>
                <span class="arch-status-text"><b>ServiceNow live push:</b> ${push.heard.toLocaleString()} record${push.heard === 1 ? '' : 's'} since this server started, the last at ${esc(when(push.lastAt))}.</span>
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-side="servicenow">Details</button>`;
        }
        return `<span class="arch-chip arch-chip-warn">🔒 Needs ServiceNow authentication</span>
            <span class="arch-status-text"><b>${esc(s.headline)}</b> No data can arrive until then.</span>
            <span class="arch-status-actions">
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-side="servicenow">What it needs</button>
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-flow="servicenow">▶ See how it will work</button>
            </span>`;
    }

    function railHtml() {
        if (railMin) {
            return `<button type="button" class="arch-rail-toggle" data-do="rail" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Show the views and layers" title="Show the views and layers">▶<span class="arch-rail-toggle-text"> Views and layers</span></button>`;
        }
        const flows = map.flows.map(f => `<button type="button" class="arch-rail-btn${f.pending ? ' arch-rail-pending' : ''}${player.flow?.id === f.id ? ' is-on' : ''}"
                data-flow="${esc(f.id)}" aria-pressed="${player.flow?.id === f.id}">
                <span aria-hidden="true">${esc(f.icon)}</span> ${esc(f.name)}${f.pending && !receiving() ? ' <span class="arch-lock" title="Needs ServiceNow authentication">🔒</span>' : ''}</button>`).join('');
        const layers = map.layers.map(l => `<button type="button" class="arch-rail-btn${focusLayer === l.id ? ' is-on' : ''}" data-layer="${esc(l.id)}"
                aria-pressed="${focusLayer === l.id}" title="${esc(l.hint)}" style="--arch-c: ${colorVar(l.color)}">
                <span class="arch-swatch" aria-hidden="true"></span> ${esc(l.name)}</button>`).join('');
        return `
            <div class="arch-mode" role="group" aria-label="How to show the map">
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn${mode === '3d' ? ' is-on' : ''}" data-do="3d" aria-pressed="${mode === '3d'}"${world ? '' : ' disabled title="This browser can\'t draw 3D here"'}>🧊 3D</button>
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn${mode === 'list' ? ' is-on' : ''}" data-do="list" aria-pressed="${mode === 'list'}">📝 List</button>
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-do="reset" title="Back to the whole map"${mode === '3d' && world ? '' : ' disabled'}>↺</button>
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-do="rail" aria-expanded="true" aria-label="Hide the views and layers" title="Hide the views and layers">◀</button>
            </div>
            <h3 class="arch-rail-head">What happens when…</h3>
            <div class="arch-rail-group">${flows}</div>
            <h3 class="arch-rail-head">Layers</h3>
            <div class="arch-rail-group">${layers}</div>`;
    }

    // A time as this person reads it
    function when(iso) {
        const date = iso ? new Date(iso) : null;
        return date && !Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? date.toLocaleString() : 'not known';
    }

    // One block: what it is, how it's protected, what it talks to, where its code is
    function nodeHtml(node, Heading = 'h3') {
        const layer = layerById(node.layer);
        const facts = node.facts.map(([k, v]) => `<dt>${esc(k)}</dt><dd>${esc(v)}</dd>`).join('');
        const talks = map.links.filter(l => l.from === node.id || l.to === node.id).map(l => {
            const out = l.from === node.id;
            const other = nodeById(out ? l.to : l.from);
            return `<li><span class="arch-arrow" aria-label="${out ? 'To' : 'From'}">${out ? '→' : '←'}</span>
                <button type="button" class="arch-link" data-node="${esc(other.id)}">${esc(other.name)}</button>
                <span class="arch-link-note">${esc(l.label)}${l.kind === 'pending' && !receiving() ? ' (once authenticated)' : ''}</span></li>`;
        }).join('');
        const notice = node.pending && !receiving()
            ? `<p class="arch-notice">🔒 ${esc(map.servicenow.headline)} <button type="button" class="arch-link" data-side="servicenow">See what it needs</button></p>` : '';
        return `
            <div class="arch-node-head" style="--arch-c: ${colorVar(layer.color)}">
                <span class="arch-swatch" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                <span class="arch-node-layer">${esc(layer.name)}</span>
            </div>
            <${Heading} class="arch-node-name">${esc(node.name)}</${Heading}>
            <p class="arch-node-tech">${esc(node.tech)}${node.version ? ` · <b>${esc(node.version)}</b>` : ''}</p>
            ${notice}
            <p>${esc(node.what)}</p>
            ${facts ? `<dl class="arch-facts">${facts}</dl>` : ''}
            <h4>How it's protected</h4>
            <p>${esc(node.secure)}</p>
            ${talks ? `<h4>Connected to</h4><ul class="arch-talks">${talks}</ul>` : ''}
            <h4>In the code</h4>
            <ul class="arch-files">${node.files.map(f => `<li><code>${esc(f)}</code></li>`).join('')}</ul>`;
    }

    function stackHtml() {
        return map.stack.map(g => `
            <h4>${esc(g.group)}</h4>
            <table class="arch-stack"><tbody>${g.items.map(i => `
                <tr><th scope="row">${esc(i.name)}</th><td class="arch-stack-version">${esc(i.version || 'not known')}</td><td>${esc(i.role)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
            </tbody></table>`).join('');
    }

    // The push: what's built, what it can't do without ServiceNow, what's been heard
    function servicenowHtml(Heading = 'h3') {
        const s = map.servicenow;
        const push = map.push;
        const heard = receiving()
            ? `<p class="arch-notice arch-notice-good">🔓 <b>${push.heard.toLocaleString()} record${push.heard === 1 ? '' : 's'}</b> heard since this server started, the last at ${esc(when(push.lastAt))}${push.last ? ` (${esc(push.last)})` : ''}.</p>`
            : `<p class="arch-notice"><b>🔒 ${esc(s.headline)}</b></p>`;
        return `
            <${Heading} class="arch-node-name">🔌 ServiceNow live push</${Heading}>
            ${heard}
            <p>${esc(s.summary)}</p>
            <div class="arch-evidence">
                <div><span>Records heard</span><b>${push.heard.toLocaleString()}</b></div>
                <div><span>Since</span><b>${esc(when(push.since))}</b></div>
                <div><span>This server listening</span><b>${push.listening ? 'Yes' : 'Not right now'}</b></div>
            </div>
            <p class="arch-small">${esc(s.evidence)}</p>
            <h4>${receiving() ? 'What it depends on' : 'What it needs before it can work'}</h4>
            <ol class="arch-needs">${s.needs.map(n => `<li><b>${esc(n.title)}</b> ${esc(n.text)}</li>`).join('')}</ol>
            <p class="arch-small">${esc(s.direction)}</p>
            <h4>What's already built</h4>
            <ul class="arch-built">${s.built.map(b => `<li>${esc(b)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>
            <h4>The steps for ServiceNow</h4>
            <p><code>${esc(s.blueprint)}</code></p>
            <button type="button" class="arch-btn arch-btn-wide" data-flow="servicenow">▶ See how it ${receiving() ? 'works' : 'will work'}</button>`;
    }

    function overviewHtml() {
        return `
            <h3 class="arch-node-name">How OneTouch fits together</h3>
            <p>${esc(map.overview)}</p>
            <h4>Find your way around</h4>
            <ul class="arch-built">
                <li>Click any block for what it does, how it's protected and where its code is.</li>
                <li>Pick a <b>What happens when…</b> to follow a real request through the system, step by step.</li>
                <li>Moving dots show which way data goes. They aren't live traffic.</li>
                <li>The dashed amber path is the ServiceNow live push. Nothing moves on it until ServiceNow is authenticated.</li>
            </ul>`;
    }

    function renderSide() {
        const side = $('arch-side');
        if (!side) return;
        const node = selected && nodeById(selected);
        const count = problems().length;
        const reported = issues?.openCount || 0;
        const tabs = [['details', '🧩 Details'], ['stack', '📚 Stack'], ['health', `🩺 Health${count ? ` (${count})` : ''}`],
            ['reports', `📣 Reports${reported ? ` (${reported})` : ''}`], ['servicenow', '🔌 ServiceNow']];
        // A redraw of the same tab stays where the person had scrolled to
        const scrolled = sideShown === sideTab ? side.querySelector('.arch-side-body')?.scrollTop || 0 : 0;
        const body = sideTab === 'health' ? healthHtml()
            : sideTab === 'reports' ? reportsHtml()
            : sideTab === 'stack' ? stackHtml()
            : sideTab === 'servicenow' ? servicenowHtml()
            : node ? nodeHtml(node) : overviewHtml();
        side.innerHTML = `
            <div class="arch-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Details">${tabs.map(([id, label]) => `
                <button type="button" role="tab" class="arch-tab${sideTab === id ? ' is-on' : ''}" aria-selected="${sideTab === id}" data-side="${id}">${label}</button>`).join('')}
            </div>
            <div class="arch-side-body" role="tabpanel" tabindex="0">${body}</div>`;
        side.querySelector('.arch-side-body').scrollTop = scrolled;
        sideShown = sideTab;
    }

    function renderStep() {
        const box = $('arch-step');
        if (!box) return;
        const flow = player.flow;
        box.hidden = !flow || mode !== '3d';
        if (box.hidden) return;
        const step = flow.steps[player.index];
        const chip = {
            needs: '<span class="arch-chip arch-chip-warn">Needs setting up in ServiceNow</span>',
            stop: '<span class="arch-chip arch-chip-stop">🔒 Needs ServiceNow authentication</span>',
            after: '<span class="arch-chip">Built. Runs once authenticated</span>',
        }[step.phase] || '';
        box.className = `arch-step${step.stop ? ' arch-step-stop' : ''}`;
        box.innerHTML = `
            <div class="arch-step-head">
                <span><span aria-hidden="true">${esc(flow.icon)}</span> <b>${esc(flow.name)}</b></span>
                <span class="arch-step-count">Step ${player.index + 1} of ${flow.steps.length}</span>
                <button type="button" class="arch-icon-btn" data-do="close" aria-label="Stop following this">✕</button>
            </div>
            ${chip}
            <h3>${esc(step.title)}</h3>
            <p>${esc(step.text)}</p>
            ${flow.pending ? `<p class="arch-small">An animation of how it ${receiving() ? 'works, not a live view' : 'will work. Nothing is sent to or from ServiceNow'}.</p>` : ''}
            <div class="arch-step-nav">
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-do="back"${player.index ? '' : ' disabled'}>◀ Back</button>
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-do="play" aria-pressed="${player.playing}">${player.playing ? '⏸ Pause' : '▶ Play'}</button>
                <button type="button" class="arch-btn" data-do="next"${player.index < flow.steps.length - 1 ? '' : ' disabled'}>Next ▶</button>
            </div>`;
    }

    function renderList() {
        const list = $('arch-list');
        if (!list) return;
        const note = world ? '' : '<p class="arch-notice">This browser can\'t draw the 3D map here, so here it is as a list.</p>';
        const flows = map.flows.map(f => `
            <article class="arch-item" id="arch-flow-${esc(f.id)}" tabindex="-1">
                <h4 class="arch-node-name"><span aria-hidden="true">${esc(f.icon)}</span> ${esc(f.name)}</h4>
                <ol class="arch-needs">${f.steps.map(s => `<li><b>${esc(s.title)}</b> ${esc(s.text)}</li>`).join('')}</ol>
            </article>`).join('');
        const layers = map.layers.map(l => {
            const nodes = map.nodes.filter(n => n.layer === l.id);
            return `<section class="arch-list-layer" id="arch-layer-${esc(l.id)}"><h3>${esc(l.name)}</h3><p class="arch-small">${esc(l.hint)}</p>
                ${nodes.map(n => `<article class="arch-item" id="arch-item-${esc(n.id)}" tabindex="-1">${nodeHtml(n, 'h4')}</article>`).join('')}</section>`;
        }).join('');
        list.innerHTML = `${note}
            <section class="arch-list-layer"><h2>🧊 Architecture</h2><p>${esc(map.overview)}</p></section>
            <section class="arch-list-layer arch-item" id="arch-list-health" tabindex="-1">${healthHtml('h3')}</section>
            <section class="arch-list-layer arch-item" id="arch-list-reports" tabindex="-1">${reportsHtml('h3')}</section>
            <section class="arch-list-layer arch-item" id="arch-list-servicenow" tabindex="-1">${servicenowHtml('h3')}</section>
            <section class="arch-list-layer"><h3>Tech stack</h3>${stackHtml()}</section>
            <section class="arch-list-layer"><h3>What happens when…</h3>${flows}</section>
            ${layers}`;
    }

    function setMode(next) {
        mode = next === '3d' && world ? '3d' : 'list';
        const root = $('architecture');
        root.classList.toggle('arch-is-list', mode === 'list');
        $('arch-stage').hidden = mode !== '3d';
        $('arch-list').hidden = mode !== 'list';
        if (mode === 'list') {
            stopFlow();
            world?.sleep();
            renderList();
        } else {
            world.resize();
            if (active) world.wake();
        }
        $('arch-rail').innerHTML = railHtml();
        renderStep();
    }

    // In the list, a button that would change the scene goes to that part instead
    function goToInList(id) {
        const el = $(id);
        if (!el) return;
        el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
        if (el.tabIndex >= 0) el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // What's picked: a block, a layer or a flow
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    function select(id, { fly = true } = {}) {
        selected = id;
        sideTab = 'details';
        renderSide();
        if (mode === 'list') {
            if (id) goToInList(`arch-item-${id}`);
            return;
        }
        if (player.flow) return;
        focusLayer = null;
        $('arch-rail').innerHTML = railHtml();
        world?.showFocus(fly);
    }

    function pickLayer(id) {
        focusLayer = focusLayer === id ? null : id;
        selected = null;
        if (player.flow) stopFlow();
        renderSide();
        $('arch-rail').innerHTML = railHtml();
        if (mode === 'list') {
            if (focusLayer) goToInList(`arch-layer-${focusLayer}`);
            return;
        }
        world?.showFocus(true);
    }

    function startFlow(id) {
        const flow = map.flows.find(f => f.id === id);
        if (!flow) return;
        if (mode === 'list') {
            goToInList(`arch-flow-${id}`);
            return;
        }
        selected = null;
        focusLayer = null;
        player.flow = flow;
        player.playing = !lessMotion();
        // The push's flow beside what it needs
        if (flow.pending) sideTab = 'servicenow';
        goToStep(0);
        renderSide();
        $('arch-rail').innerHTML = railHtml();
    }

    function goToStep(index) {
        const step = player.flow.steps[index];
        player.index = index;
        player.elapsed = 0;
        // Long enough to read it
        player.hold = Math.max(3500, 1800 + step.text.length * 42);
        // The gate is the point of this flow: the animation waits there
        if (step.stop) player.playing = false;
        // In this order: the camera leaves room for the card, so it needs its size
        renderStep();
        world?.playStep(step);
    }

    function stopFlow() {
        if (!player.flow) return;
        player.flow = null;
        player.playing = false;
        world?.endStep();
        renderStep();
    }

    function tickPlayer(ms) {
        if (!player.flow || !player.playing) return;
        player.elapsed += ms;
        if (player.elapsed < player.hold) return;
        if (player.index < player.flow.steps.length - 1) goToStep(player.index + 1);
        else { player.playing = false; renderStep(); }
    }

    // Every button on the page, in one place
    function onClick(event) {
        // A name over a block, or anything else that's a button on this page
        const el = event.target.closest('[data-issue], [data-node], [data-flow], [data-layer], [data-side], [data-do]');
        if (!el || !$('architecture').contains(el)) return;
        if (el.dataset.issue) {
            setIssue(el, el.dataset.issue, el.dataset.issueStatus);
        } else if (el.dataset.node) {
            if (player.flow) stopFlow();
            select(el.dataset.node);
        } else if (el.dataset.flow) {
            startFlow(el.dataset.flow);
        } else if (el.dataset.layer) {
            pickLayer(el.dataset.layer);
        } else if (el.dataset.side) {
            sideTab = el.dataset.side;
            renderSide();
            if (mode === 'list' && sideTab === 'servicenow') goToInList('arch-list-servicenow');
            if (mode === 'list' && sideTab === 'health') goToInList('arch-list-health');
            if (mode === 'list' && sideTab === 'reports') goToInList('arch-list-reports');
        } else {
            act(el.dataset.do);
        }
    }

    function act(what) {
        if (what === 'rail') setRailMin(!railMin);
        else if (what === '3d' || what === 'list') setMode(what);
        else if (what === 'reset') resetView();
        else if (what === 'close') { stopFlow(); $('arch-rail').innerHTML = railHtml(); world?.showFocus(true); }
        else if (what === 'back' && player.flow && player.index > 0) goToStep(player.index - 1);
        else if (what === 'next' && player.flow && player.index < player.flow.steps.length - 1) goToStep(player.index + 1);
        else if (what === 'play' && player.flow) {
            player.playing = !player.playing;
            // Play at the last step: from the start again
            if (player.playing && player.index === player.flow.steps.length - 1) goToStep(0);
            else renderStep();
        }
    }

    // The left side bar, in to the side and back; this browser remembers which
    function setRailMin(min) {
        railMin = min;
        try { localStorage.setItem(RAIL_KEY, min ? '1' : '0'); } catch { /* Just for this visit */ }
        paintRail();
        $('arch-rail').querySelector('[data-do="rail"]')?.focus();
    }
    function paintRail() {
        $('architecture').classList.toggle('arch-rail-min', railMin);
        $('arch-rail').classList.toggle('arch-rail-closed', railMin);
        $('arch-rail').innerHTML = railHtml();
        if (mode === '3d') world?.resize();
    }

    function resetView() {
        selected = null;
        focusLayer = null;
        stopFlow();
        renderSide();
        $('arch-rail').innerHTML = railHtml();
        world?.home();
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // The push's status, while the page is open
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------

    function paintPush(before) {
        const status = $('arch-status');
        if (!status || !map) return;
        const list = problems();
        const key = `${map.push.state}:${map.push.heard}:${list.map(p => `${p.id}=${p.text}`).join('|')}:${issues?.openCount || 0}:${issues?.open[0]?.id || 0}`;
        if (status.dataset.key !== key) {
            status.dataset.key = key;
            status.innerHTML = statusHtml();
            status.classList.toggle('arch-status-good', receiving() && !list.length);
            status.classList.toggle('arch-status-bad', list.length > 0);
            // The banner's height may have changed, and the scene is centered below it
            if (mode === '3d') world?.resize();
            world?.setProblems(list.map(p => p.node).filter(Boolean));
        }
        world?.setPushState(receiving());
        if (before !== undefined && map.push.heard > before) world?.pulse(map.servicenow.arrives);
    }

    async function fetchMap() {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/architecture`, { headers: authHeaders() });
        if (handleUnauthorized(response)) return null;
        const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'The map could not be loaded right now.');
        return data;
    }

    // The health report. Not getting one is itself a problem to report: a server
    // that can't reach its database, or isn't answering, can't say so any other way.
    async function pollHealth() {
        if (!active || !map) return;
        const session = opening;
        const before = JSON.stringify(health?.checks.map(c => [c.id, c.state, c.text])) + healthError;
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/architecture/health`, { headers: authHeaders() });
            if (handleUnauthorized(response) || session !== opening) return;
            const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (session !== opening) return;
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `The server answered with an error (${response.status}).`);
            health = data;
            healthError = null;
            healthErrorSince = null;
        } catch (error) {
            if (session !== opening) return;
            healthError = error instanceof TypeError ? 'This page can\'t reach the server.' : error.message;
            healthErrorSince ||= new Date().toISOString();
        }
        paintPush();
        if (before !== JSON.stringify(health?.checks.map(c => [c.id, c.state, c.text])) + healthError) {
            renderSide();
            if (mode === 'list') renderList();
        } else if (sideTab === 'health' && !$('arch-side')?.contains(document.activeElement)) {
            // Only the "Checked at" times moved: not worth taking the keys from someone
            renderSide();
        }
    }

    // What people have reported. If this fails, the health report says why.
    async function pollIssues() {
        if (!active || !map) return;
        const session = opening;
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/architecture/issues`, { headers: authHeaders() });
            if (handleUnauthorized(response) || !response.ok) return;
            const data = await response.json();
            if (session !== opening || !map) return;
            const changed = JSON.stringify(data) !== JSON.stringify(issues);
            issues = data;
            if (!changed) return;
            paintPush();
            renderSide();
            if (mode === 'list') renderList();
        } catch { /* Tried again shortly */ }
    }

    // Resolved, or back on the list
    async function setIssue(button, id, status) {
        button.disabled = true;
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/architecture/issues/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
                method: 'PUT',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...authHeaders() },
                body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
            });
            if (handleUnauthorized(response)) return;
            const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'That could not be changed right now.');
            await pollIssues();
            // The button has gone with its report: the keys go to the list it was in
            document.querySelector('.arch-side-body')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        } catch (error) {
            button.disabled = false;
            showToast(`❌ ${error.message}`);
        }
    }

    async function pollPush() {
        pollHealth();
        pollIssues();
        if (!active || !map) return;
        const session = opening;
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/architecture/push`, { headers: authHeaders() });
            if (handleUnauthorized(response) || !response.ok) return;
            const push = await response.json();
```
